ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, da wir dieses Thema gestern in unserem Fischereiausschuss behandelt haben, möchte ich Sie im Namen des Ausschusses sowie und vor allem im Namen der Berichterstatter, die wir heute über das Thema debattieren werden, darum bitten, sofern der Herr Kommissar, mit dem ich gesprochen habe, keine Einwände hat - und die hat er im Prinzip nicht -, dass wir zunächst die Erklärung des Kommissars selbst hören und wir, die übrigen Berichterstatter, entsprechend der festgelegten Reihenfolge im Anschluss daran zu Wort kommen können.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, since we have already discussed this topic in our Fisheries Committee yesterday, I would like to ask you, on behalf of the committee and above all on behalf of the rapporteurs who we will be debating on this topic today, to please, if the Commissioner with whom I have spoken has no objections - and he doesn't, in principle - that we first hear the Commissioner's explanation and that the rest of the rapporteurs can then speak in the established order afterwards.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, since we dealt with this issue yesterday in our Fisheries Committee, I would like to ask you, on behalf of the Committee and, above all, on behalf of the rapporteurs who will debate this issue today, to ask the Commissioner, whom I spoke to, if he has any objections - and he has not, in principle - that we first hear the Commissioner's statement and that we, the other rapporteurs, can speak in turn according to the established order.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, as we discussed this topic in our Fisheries Committee yesterday, I would like to request, on behalf of the Committee and especially on behalf of the rapporteurs who will debate this topic today, that we first hear the statement from the Commissioner himself, provided that Mr. Commissioner, whom I spoke with, has no objections - and he essentially does not have any - and that we, the other rapporteurs, can then speak in turn according to the established order.

ilsp.query: Wir sollten deshalb eine aktive Politik betreiben, sowohl bei den Fischereiabkommen mit Drittländern, die an die jeweilige Situation anzupassen sind, als auch in den regionalen Fischereiorganisationen, in denen wir, wie so oft gesagt, die Führung übernehmen müssen und uns nicht damit zufrieden geben dürfen, dass die fünfzehn Staaten, die derzeit die Europäische Union bilden - morgen sind es vielleicht zwanzig oder fünfundzwanzig -, immer das gleiche Gewicht behalten wie zum Beispiel heute Estland.
ilsp.judge: We should therefore pursue an active policy, both in the fishing agreements with third countries that need to be adapted to the respective situation, as well as in the regional fishing organizations, in which we, as often said, have to take the lead and cannot be satisfied with the fact that the fifteen states currently forming the European Union - tomorrow it may be twenty or twenty-five - always maintain the same weight, for example, as Estonia does today.
ilsp.proxy: We should therefore pursue an active policy, both in the fisheries agreements with third countries, which must be adapted to the respective situation, as well as in the regional fisheries organizations, in which we must, as often said, take the lead and not be content with the fact that the fifteen states that currently make up the European Union - tomorrow there may be twenty or twenty-five - always have the same weight as, for example, today Estonia.
ilsp.reference: We should therefore pursue an active policy both in fisheries agreements with third countries, which need to be tailored to the respective situation, as well as in regional fisheries organizations, in which we must take the lead, as we often say, and cannot content ourselves with the fact that the fifteen states that currently make up the European Union - tomorrow there might be twenty or twenty-five - always retain the same weight as, for example, Estonia does today.

ilsp.query: In den Schlussfolgerungen zu ihrer Mitteilung führt die Kommission u. a. folgende Prioritäten auf: verbesserte Kohärenz unter den verschiedenen Zielen, die die GFP verfolgt, wie etwa die Erhaltung der Ressourcen, die Wirtschaftlichkeit der Fischereiflotten und die Arbeitsplatzsicherung in Gebieten, die von der Fischerei abhängig sind; Berücksichtigung der wirtschaftlichen Dimension der Fischereibewirtschaftung; verbesserte Integration der Umwelt- und der Fischereipolitik; Verbesserung der Bewirtschaftungsinstrumente, wie beispielsweise die mehrjährigen Bewirtschaftungsziele und -pläne, die Steuerung des Fischereiaufwands und die vollständige Integration des Mittelmeerraums in die Bewirtschaftungsregelung der Gemeinschaft; ein übersichtlicherer Entscheidungsfindungsprozess und die Erhaltung der externen Dimension der GFP.
ilsp.judge: In the conclusions to their report, the Commission, inter alia, highlights the following priorities: improved coherence among the various objectives pursued by the GFP, such as the conservation of resources, the economic viability of fishing fleets and job security in areas dependent on fishing; consideration of the economic dimension of fisheries management; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policy; improvement of management instruments, such as multi-annual management objectives and plans, the control of fishing effort and the full integration of the Mediterranean area into the Community's management regulation; a more streamlined decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the GFP.
ilsp.proxy: In its conclusions to its communication, the Commission also lists the following priorities: improved coherence among the various objectives pursued by the GFP, such as the conservation of resources, the economic viability of fishing fleets, and job security in areas dependent on fishing; consideration of the economic dimension of fisheries management; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policy; improvement of management instruments, such as multiannual management objectives and plans, the control of fishing effort, and the full integration of the Mediterranean into the Community's management regulation; a more transparent decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the GFP.
ilsp.reference: In the conclusions of their communication, the Commission highlights the following priorities: improved coherence among the various objectives pursued by the Common Fisheries Policy (CFP), such as the conservation of resources, the economic viability of fishing fleets, and job security in regions dependent on fisheries; consideration of the economic dimension of fisheries management; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policies; better management tools, such as multi-annual management plans and objectives, the regulation of fishing effort, and the full integration of the Mediterranean into the Community's management regulation; a more transparent decision-making process and the maintenance of the external dimension of the CFP.

ilsp.query: Im Einzelnen möchte Ihr Berichterstatter einige Vorschläge hervorheben, insbesondere die Aufrechterhaltung des Status quo bezüglich der 6/12-Meilen-Zone. Weiterhin die Beibehaltung der Schutzzonen nach wissenschaftlichen Gutachten und damit zwangsläufig die Frage des Zugangs zur Nordsee, der angesichts der Erweiterungen konsequenter gehandhabt werden muss.
ilsp.judge: In particular, the rapporteur would like to highlight some proposals, especially the maintenance of the status quo regarding the 6/12-mile zone. Furthermore, the retention of protection zones based on scientific assessments, which necessarily raises the question of access to the North Sea, which must be handled more consistently in light of the expansions.
ilsp.proxy: In particular, your rapporteur would like to highlight some proposals, in particular the maintenance of the status quo regarding the 6/12-mile zone. Also the retention of the protected zones based on scientific reports and thus inevitably the question of access to the North Sea, which must be handled consistently in view of the extensions.
ilsp.reference: In particular, your reporter wishes to highlight some proposals, especially the maintenance of the status quo regarding the 6/12-mile zone. Additionally, the retention of protection zones based on scientific assessments necessarily raises the question of access to the North Sea, which must be handled more consistently in light of the expansions.

ilsp.query: Verbunden mit einer juristischen Formulierung soll wie zuvor auch nach diesem neuen Text den Behörden von Guinea-Bissau eine Summe zur Verfügung gestellt werden, die dem nicht ausgezahlten Teil der finanziellen Gegenleistung aus dem geltenden Protokoll entspricht. Dieser Betrag in Höhe von ca. 6,5 Mio. Euro ist ausschließlich vorgesehen für die Unterstützung des lokalen Fischerei, der Verstärkung der Kontrollmaßnahmen und für die Wiederherstellung der beschädigten Fischereiinfrastrukturen.
ilsp.judge: Linked to a legal formulation, it is intended, as before, that after this new text, an amount be made available to the authorities of Guinea-Bissau, corresponding to the unpaid portion of the financial compensation from the applicable protocol. This amount of approximately 6.5 million euros is exclusively intended for the support of local fishing, the strengthening of control measures, and the restoration of damaged fishing infrastructure.
ilsp.proxy: Linked to a legal formulation, as before, also after this new text, the authorities of Guinea-Bissau will be provided with a sum that corresponds to the unpaid part of the financial counter-performance under the current protocol. This amount of approximately 6.5 million euros is exclusively intended for the support of local fisheries, the strengthening of control measures, and for the restoration of damaged fishing infrastructure.
ilsp.reference: Linked to a legal formulation, funds shall also be made available to the authorities of Guinea-Bissau according to this new text, corresponding to the unpaid part of the financial counter-payment from the current protocol. This amount of approximately 6.5 million euros is exclusively intended for the support of local fisheries, strengthening control measures, and restoring damaged fishing infrastructure.

ilsp.query: Da der von der Kommission vorgelegte Vorschlag im Wesentlichen derselbe ist, dem wir im März 1999 zugestimmt haben, und da der veranschlagte Finanzbetrag, der derselbe wie im geltenden Protokoll ist, wie der Vorschlag für konkrete Zwecke bestimmt ist, halte ich es als Berichterstatter für angebracht, dass das Parlament diesem Vorschlag zustimmt.
ilsp.judge: Since the proposal put forward by the Commission is essentially the same as the one we agreed to in March 1999, and since the estimated financial amount, which is the same as in the current protocol, is determined for specific purposes, I consider it as rapporteur appropriate that the Parliament approves this proposal.
ilsp.proxy: Since the proposal submitted by the Commission is essentially the same as the one we agreed to in March 1999, and since the estimated financial allocation is the same as in the current protocol and is determined for specific purposes, I believe it is appropriate for the rapporteur that the Parliament agrees to this proposal.
ilsp.reference: Since the proposal presented by the Commission is essentially the same as the one we agreed to in March 1999, and since the estimated financial amount, which is the same as in the current protocol, is specifically determined for concrete purposes, I consider it appropriate as rapporteur for the Parliament to agree to this proposal.

ilsp.query: Ihre Anwesenheit geht auf ein Ersuchen der PSE-Fraktion in der Konferenz der Präsidenten zurück, und ich erinnere Sie daran, dass Sie im Oktober 1999, einen Monat vor dem Auslaufen des Abkommens, hier sagten, dass Sie sich "massiv dafür einsetzen würden, dass es hier zu einer Lösung kommt " und dass Sie "auch nasse Füße in Kauf nehmen würden ".
ilsp.judge: Your presence is a result of a request from the PSE faction in the Conference of Presidents, and I remind you that in October 1999, a month before the agreement expired, you said here that you would "massively work towards a solution" and that you would "even take wet feet" in the process.
ilsp.proxy: Your presence is due to a request from the PSE group in the Conference of Presidents, and I remind you that you said in October 1999, a month before the expiry of the agreement, that you would "strongly advocate that a solution is found here" and that you would "also take wet feet in hand".
ilsp.reference: Your presence traces back to a request from the PSE faction at the Conference of Presidents, and I remind you that in October 1999, one month before the expiration of the agreement, you said that you would "strongly advocate for a solution to be found here" and that you were "prepared to get your feet wet."

ilsp.query: Das Problem besteht für mich darin, dass es keine Abstimmung zwischen den Bemühungen der verschiedenen Dienste der Kommission gegeben hat, dass kein ausreichender politischer Impuls des Rates vorhanden war und es seitens der Regierung des am stärksten betroffenen Landes keine deutlichen Worte, kein kluges Vorgehen und keine parallele Arbeit gegeben hat, was meiner Meinung nach der gravierendste Punkt ist.
ilsp.judge: The problem lies in the fact that there has been no coordination between the efforts of the various services of the commission, that there was no sufficient political impetus from the council, and that from the government of the most affected country, there were no clear words, no wise approach, and no parallel work, which in my opinion is the most critical point.
ilsp.proxy: The problem for me is that there has been no consultation between the efforts of the various services of the Commission, that there was no sufficient political impetus from the Council, and that there has been no clear words, no wise action and no parallel work from the government of the most affected country, which in my opinion is the gravest point.
ilsp.reference: The problem for me lies in the lack of coordination between the efforts of the various Commission services, the absence of a sufficient political impetus from the Council, and the lack of clear words, wise action, and parallel work on the part of the government of the most affected country, which I consider to be the gravest point.

ilsp.query: Wir verbringen hier ganze Tage mit der Diskussion über das demokratische Defizit und die verantwortungsvolle Regierung der Union und wenn wir dann eine Angelegenheit behandeln, die direkte Auswirkungen auf über 4 000 Fischer hat, wollen wir nicht sehen, was offenkundig ist, und nicht tun, was jede Regierung tun würde, um einen so bedeutenden Teil ihres produktiven Geflechts zu schützen.
ilsp.judge: We spend whole days here discussing the democratic deficit and the Union's responsible government, and when we then deal with a matter that has direct impacts on over 4,000 fishermen, we don't want to see what's obvious and we won't do what any government would do to protect such a significant part of their productive network.
ilsp.proxy: We spend entire days discussing the democratic deficit and the responsible government of the Union, and then we deal with an issue that has direct effects on over 4,000 fishermen, and we don't want to see what is obvious, and we don't do what any government would do to protect such an important part of its productive fabric.
ilsp.reference: We spend entire days discussing the democratic deficit and responsible governance of the Union, and then we address an issue that directly affects over 4,000 fishermen, yet we refuse to see what is obvious and fail to do what any government would do to protect such an important part of its productive fabric.

ilsp.query: Auf der Grundlage der ICES-Gebiete und unter Einbeziehung der Interessenvertreter der Fischerei, der Wissenschaft und des Naturschutzes sollte ein System der zonalen Bewirtschaftung eingeführt werden. Dabei geht es nicht um die Renationalisierung der GFP oder eine Einschränkung der Befugnisse des Rates oder der Kommission, sondern darum, jedem Mitgliedstaat mit Quoten in einer bestimmten Zone die Möglichkeit zu geben, sich an der Erarbeitung und Empfehlung von Kontrollmaßnahmen zu beteiligen, die den Erfordernissen dieser Gebiete entsprechen und damit größere Aussicht auf Erfolg haben.
ilsp.judge: Based on the ICES areas and incorporating the interests of the fishing industry, science, and conservation, a system of zonal management should be introduced. This is not about renationalizing the GFP or restricting the powers of the Council or the Commission, but rather about giving each member state with quotas in a specific zone the opportunity to participate in the development and recommendation of control measures that meet the needs of these areas and thus have a greater prospect of success.
ilsp.proxy: Based on the ICES areas and taking into account the interests of the fishing industry, science, and conservation, a system of zonal management should be introduced. This is not about renationalizing the GFP or limiting the powers of the Council or the Commission, but about giving each member state with quotas in a certain zone the opportunity to participate in the development and recommendation of control measures that meet the needs of these areas and thus have a greater chance of success.
ilsp.reference: Based on the ICES areas and involving representatives of fisheries, science, and nature conservation interests, a system of zonal management should be introduced. This is not about renationalizing the Common Fisheries Policy (CFP) or limiting the powers of the Council or Commission, but rather about giving each Member State with quotas in a specific zone the opportunity to participate in the development and recommendation of control measures that meet the needs of these areas and thus have a greater chance of success.

ilsp.query: Wir sind nicht für die Vergabe von Subventionen zur Förderung der extrem industrialisierten Fischerei, jener Fischerei, die alles ohne Unterschied fängt auf das Risiko hin, die Arten zu gefährden, die Ernährungssicherheit und die Artenvielfalt zu beeinträchtigen, jener Fischerei, die zu einer übermäßigen Vergrößerung der Flotten führt usw. In diesem Zusammenhang sind wir der Meinung, dass die unkontrollierten Marktkräfte eine der Hauptursachen darstellen, die zu dieser Überinvestition führt, und dass diese Fragen im Rahmen der künftigen WTO-Verhandlungen über die Liberalisierung des Handels berücksichtigt werden müssen.
ilsp.judge: We are not in favor of the allocation of subsidies to promote the extremely industrialized fishing industry, that fishing industry which catches everything without distinction at the risk of endangering species, impairing food security and biodiversity, that fishing industry which leads to an excessive expansion of the fleets, etc. In this context, we believe that uncontrolled market forces are one of the main causes leading to this overinvestment, and that these issues must be taken into account in the framework of future WTO negotiations on trade liberalization.
ilsp.proxy: We are not in favor of the allocation of subsidies to promote the extremely industrialized fishing, that fishing that catches everything without discrimination at the risk of endangering species, compromising food security and biodiversity, that fishing that leads to an excessive increase in fleets, etc. In this context, we believe that uncontrolled market forces represent one of the main causes that lead to this over-investment, and that these issues must be taken into account in the framework of future WTO negotiations on the liberalization of trade.
ilsp.reference: We are not in favor of subsidies for the promotion of extremely industrialized fishing, that kind of fishing which catches everything indiscriminately at the risk of endangering species, compromising food security, and reducing biodiversity. In this context, we believe that uncontrolled market forces represent one of the main causes leading to this overinvestment, and that these issues must be taken into account within the framework of future WTO negotiations on the liberalization of trade.

ilsp.query: Jetzt müssen wir daran arbeiten, dass gerade in diesem beispielhaften Sektor die gemeinsame Politik nicht aufgegeben wird, doch um dies zu tun, müssen wir denjenigen eine Antwort geben, die sich darüber beklagen - und das sind die Akteure -, dass es keine ausreichende Mitwirkung gibt, dass keine Zustimmung zu den getroffenen Entscheidungen eingeholt wird, mit anderen Worten, dass keine Teilhabe am Entscheidungsprozess stattfindet.
ilsp.judge: Now we need to work on the fact that in this exemplary sector, the joint policy is not being given up, but to do this, we need to give an answer to those who complain about it - and that are the actors - that there is insufficient participation, that no consent is obtained for the decisions made, in other words, that there is no involvement in the decision-making process.
ilsp.proxy: Now we have to work on the fact that in this exemplary sector, the common policy is not abandoned, but to do so, we have to give an answer to those who complain about it - and these are the actors - that there is not enough participation, that there is no consent to the decisions taken, in other words, that there is no participation in the decision-making process.
ilsp.reference: Now we must ensure that in this exemplary sector, the common policy is not abandoned, but to do so, we must address those who complain – and they are the actors – that there is not enough participation, that consent to the decisions made is not sought, in other words, that there is no involvement in the decision-making process.

ilsp.query: Einerseits ist jeder Einzelne der hier Anwesenden am Fortbestand der Fischereiindustrie interessiert, und zwar nicht zuletzt deshalb, weil wir gern dessen Produkt essen; andererseits gibt es ernst zu nehmende wissenschaftliche Hinweise auf eine Verknappung der Fischbestände, die im Falle einiger Arten deren Verschwinden zur Folge haben kann.
ilsp.judge: On the one hand, each individual present here is interested in the continuation of the fishing industry, and this is not least because we like to eat its products; on the other hand, there are serious scientific indications of a shortage of fish stocks, which in the case of certain species can lead to their disappearance.
ilsp.proxy: On the one hand, everyone present here is interested in the survival of the fishing industry, and not least because we like to eat its product; on the other hand, there are serious scientific indications of a shortage of fish stocks, which can lead to the extinction of some species.
ilsp.reference: On one hand, each and every one of us present here is interested in the survival of the fishing industry, not least because we enjoy eating its products; on the other hand, there are serious scientific indications of a decline in fish stocks that could lead to the disappearance of certain species.

ilsp.query: Zunächst möchte ich die beiden Kollegen Gallagher und Poignant zu der Art und Weise beglückwünschen, wie sie einen ersten Beitrag zu dem neuen Grünbuch geleistet haben. Insofern scheint diese Aussprache faktisch eine Vorstufe dazu zu sein, und man könnte sagen, die vorliegenden Berichte würden von uns in geziemender Weise für eine Stellungnahme dazu missbraucht.
ilsp.judge: Initially, I would like to congratulate my two colleagues Gallagher and Poignant on the manner in which they have made a first contribution to the new Green Paper. In this regard, this discussion appears to be a practical precursor to this, and one could say that the reports presented by us are being misused in an appropriate manner for a statement on this.
ilsp.proxy: First, I would like to congratulate my two colleagues, Gallagher and Poignant, on the way they have contributed to the new Green Paper. In this respect, this debate seems to be a prelude to it, and one could say that the reports before us are being misused for a proper opinion on it.

ilsp.query: Ich pflichte dem Kollegen Varela voll bei, wenn er davon spricht, dass die Auswirkungen der Globalisierung in jedem konkreten Fall unterschiedlich sind: Während sie für viele eine Herausforderung bildet, die eine Quelle von Reichtum und Chancen sein kann, ist sie für diejenigen, die sich an die tiefgreifenden Veränderungen nicht anzupassen wissen oder dazu nicht in der Lage sind, auch eine Quelle von Problemen und Unzulänglichkeiten.
ilsp.judge: I fully agree with my colleague Varela when he speaks about the fact that the effects of globalization are different in every concrete case: While it presents a challenge for many, which can be a source of wealth and opportunities, it is also a source of problems and shortcomings for those who are unable to adapt to the profound changes or are not capable of doing so.
ilsp.proxy: I fully agree with my colleague Varela when he says that the effects of globalization are different in each concrete case: While it can be a challenge for many, a source of wealth and opportunities, it is also a source of problems and deficiencies for those who do not know or are not able to adapt to the deep changes.
ilsp.reference: I fully agree with my colleague Varela when he says that the effects of globalization vary in each specific case: While it can be a challenge for many, a source of wealth and opportunities, it can also be a source of problems and deficiencies for those who are unable or unwilling to adapt to the profound changes.

ilsp.query: Dann einen Fischereisektor schaffen, der nachhaltig wirtschaftet, aber auch wirtschaftlich lebensfähig und international konkurrenzfähig ist - dabei sollten wir aber auch gleichzeitig denen helfen, die sich nach einer anderen Arbeit umsehen müssen -, eine moderne Fischereiaußenpolitik in enger Abstimmung mit den anderen Gemeinschaftspolitiken entwickeln, um eine verantwortungsbewusste und rationelle Bewirtschaftung der Ressourcen zu erreichen, und vor allem die Mittelmeerdimension neu entwickeln.
ilsp.judge: Then create a fishing sector that sustainably operates, but is also economically viable and internationally competitive - in doing so, we should also help those who need to look for another job at the same time -, develop a modern fisheries external policy in close coordination with the other community policies to achieve a responsible and rational management of resources, and above all, develop the Mediterranean dimension anew.
ilsp.proxy: Then create a fishing sector that is economically sustainable, but also economically viable and internationally competitive - while we should also help those who need to look for another job at the same time - develop a modern fishing external policy in close coordination with the other Community policies to achieve responsible and rational management of resources, and above all develop the Mediterranean dimension anew.
ilsp.reference: Then create a fishing sector that is economically sustainable but also viable and competitive on an international level – at the same time, we should also help those who need to look for other types of work – develop a modern fisheries foreign policy in close coordination with other community policies to achieve responsible and rational resource management, and especially revitalize the Mediterranean dimension.

ilsp.query: Betrachtet man die heutigen Zahlen, so stellt man plötzlich fest, dass mit einem Wirtschaftswachstum von 5 % des BSP pro Kopf, einem Exportzuwachs von nicht weniger als 12,8 % in den fünf Jahren zwischen 1993 und 1998 und sogar einem Rückgang des Bevölkerungswachstums - Senkung der Fruchtbarkeitsrate von 7 auf heute 3 Geburten je Frau - die Entwicklung als eine Erfolgsstory beschrieben werden könnte.
ilsp.judge: Examining the current numbers, one suddenly finds that with an economic growth of 5% of GDP per capita, an increase in exports of no less than 12.8% over the five years between 1993 and 1998, and even a decline in population growth - a decrease in the fertility rate from 7 to today's 3 births per woman - the development could be described as a success story.
ilsp.proxy: When considering the current numbers, one suddenly realizes that with an economic growth of 5% of GDP per capita, an export increase of at least 12.8% in the five years between 1993 and 1998, and even a decline in population growth - a reduction in fertility rate from 7 to 3 births per woman today - the development could be described as a success story.
ilsp.reference: When considering today's numbers, one suddenly realizes that with an economic growth rate of 5% per capita GDP, an export increase of at least 12.8% over five years from 1993 to 1998, and even a decline in population growth – a fertility rate dropping from 7 to 3 births per woman today – this development could be described as a success story.

ilsp.query: Nun stellt sich uns auch im Rahmen des bisher Gesagten die Frage, wie die tatsächlichen Ziele und Prioritäten dieses neuen Abkommens aussehen und welche Ergebnisse man in Sachen nachhaltige Entwicklung im Bereich der Verwaltung sowie bei der Einbeziehung der Bürger und ihrer Organisationen in das Leben der Gesellschaft erzielen will.
ilsp.judge: Now, within the context of what has been said so far, the question also arises for us as to how the actual goals and priorities of this new agreement look and what results one wants to achieve in terms of sustainable development in the field of administration as well as in the inclusion of citizens and their organizations in the life of society.

ilsp.query: Bangladesch hat Voraussetzungen, die viele andere Entwicklungsländer nicht haben, da das Land - und das halte ich für sehr wichtig - nur eine Sprache und eine Religion hat und nur aus einem Stamm besteht, was bedeutet, dass hier die ethnischen Konflikte nicht existieren, die wir z. B. in Afrika erleben, auch nicht die Religionskriege.
ilsp.judge: Bangladesh has conditions that many other developing countries do not have, as the country - and I think this is very important - only has one language and one religion and consists only of one tribe, which means that ethnic conflicts, such as those we experience in Africa, do not exist here, nor do the religious wars.
ilsp.proxy: Bangladesh has conditions that many other developing countries do not have, as the country - and I think this is very important - only has one language and one religion and only consists of one tribe, which means that here the ethnic conflicts do not exist that we experience, for example, in Africa, nor the religious wars.
ilsp.reference: Bangladesh has conditions that many other developing countries lack, as the country – and I consider this very important – has only one language and one religion and consists of only one ethnic group, which means that ethnic conflicts, which we experience, for example, in Africa, do not exist here, nor do religious wars.

ilsp.query: Die zentrale Frage, die sich uns stellt, besteht in einer genauen Untersuchung, ob es einen Zusammenhang zwischen dem Einsatz dieser Munition und den von den Truppen oder von den Personen, die auf dem Balkan in Friedensmissionen tätig waren, gemeldeten Erkrankungen gibt oder ob sich im Gegenteil diese Krankheitserscheinungen nicht von denen unterscheiden, die man bei unseren Soldaten im Allgemeinen feststellt.
ilsp.judge: The central question that arises for us consists in a precise examination of whether there is a connection between the use of this ammunition and the illnesses reported by the troops or by the people who were active on the Balkans in peace missions, or whether, on the contrary, these disease manifestations do not differ from those that we generally find in our soldiers.
ilsp.proxy: The central question that we face is a careful examination of whether there is a connection between the use of this ammunition and the illnesses reported by the troops or by the persons who were on the Balkan in peace missions, or whether, on the contrary, these disease manifestations do not differ from those that we find in our soldiers in general.
ilsp.reference: The central question that arises for us concerns a precise investigation into whether there is a connection between the use of this ammunition and the illnesses reported by the troops or by the individuals who were active on the Balkan in peace missions, or whether, on the contrary, these disease manifestations do not differ from those that we generally observe in our soldiers.

ilsp.query: Einige Tage später, genauer gesagt am 5. Mai 1999, habe ich, zusammen mit elf weiteren Kollegen, einen Brief an Herrn Solana, den damaligen NATO-Generalsekretär, geschickt, weil wir vom Einsatz dieses Waffentyps wussten und weil wir ihn um einen Verwendungsstopp bitten wollten, da es sich hierbei um Waffen handelt, die in der Folge zu Gesundheitsproblemen bei der Bevölkerung und den Angehörigen der Streitkräfte führen können, ganz zu schweigen von der irreversiblen Umweltverseuchung.
ilsp.judge: Some days later, to be more precise on May 5th, 1999, I, together with eleven other colleagues, sent a letter to Mr. Solana, the then NATO Secretary-General, because we knew about the use of this type of weapon and because we wanted to ask him to stop its use, as these weapons can lead to health problems among the population and the relatives of the military personnel, not to mention irreversible environmental pollution.
ilsp.proxy: A few days later, more precisely on May 5, 1999, I, together with eleven other colleagues, sent a letter to Mr. Solana, the then NATO Secretary-General, because we knew about the use of this type of weapon and because we wanted to ask for a suspension of its use, as it is weapons that can lead to health problems for the population and the armed forces in the future, not to mention the irreversible environmental pollution.
ilsp.reference: A few days later, to be more precise on May 5, 1999, I, together with eleven other colleagues, sent a letter to Mr. Solana, who was then the NATO Secretary-General, because we were aware of the use of this weapon type and because we requested a usage halt, as these weapons can lead to health problems for the civilian population and military personnel, not to mention the irreversible environmental pollution.

ilsp.query: Hier haben wir es aber mit einer 4 000-mal höheren Konzentration zu tun, so dass es vollkommen absurd ist, eine derartige Munition zu verwenden, die in die Umwelt gelangt und zum Entstehen von unlöslichen Partikeln führt, welche in die Atemwege und in den Magen-Darm-Trakt gelangen, und dann zu behaupten, das Vorhandensein eines Problems müsse erst bewiesen werden.
ilsp.judge: Here have we it, but with a concentration 4,000 times higher, making it completely absurd to use such ammunition that enters the environment and leads to the formation of insoluble particles, which enter the respiratory tract and the gastrointestinal tract, and then to claim that the presence of a problem must be proven.
ilsp.proxy: Here, we are dealing with a 4,000 times higher concentration, so it is completely absurd to use such ammunition that enters the environment and leads to the formation of insoluble particles, which enter the respiratory tract and the gastrointestinal tract, and then to claim that the existence of a problem must first be proven.

ilsp.query: Wir reden nicht über den letzten Beweis, und als wir in diesem Haus über unsere eigene Gesundheit und über BSE gesprochen haben, da waren wir uns auch alle einig, dass das Vorsorgeprinzip gilt, obwohl wir niemals den direkten Beweis führen konnten, dass infiziertes Material zu der neuen Variante der Creutzfeldt-Jacob-Krankheit führt.
ilsp.judge: We're not talking about the final proof, and when we were in this house discussing our own health and BSE, we were all in agreement that the precautionary principle applies, even though we could never lead direct evidence that infected material leads to the new variant of Creutzfeldt-Jacob disease.
ilsp.proxy: We are not talking about the last proof, and when we talked about our own health and BSE in this house, we were all in agreement that the precautionary principle applies, even though we could never provide direct proof that infected material leads to the new variant of Creutzfeldt-Jacob disease.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, wir behandeln heute ein äußerst wichtiges Thema, auf das eigentlich sehr viel Zeit verwendet und zu dem sehr eingehende Überlegungen angestellt werden müssten, während wir es allerdings voller Emotionen angehen, die der Politik, zu der wir doch hier als Nichtfachleute gehalten sind, schlecht zu Gesicht stehen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, we are dealing with a very important issue today, which actually requires a lot of time and thorough considerations, while we are approaching it full of emotions, which do not look good for the politics we are representing here as non-experts.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, we are dealing with a very important issue today, which should have been given a lot of time and very thorough consideration, while we are dealing with it with full emotions, which are not good for the politics to which we are supposed to be non-experts here.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, we are dealing with a topic of utmost importance today, one that should actually require a great deal of time and thorough consideration, while we are approaching it with emotions that do not bode well for the politics to which we, as non-experts here, are expected to contribute.

ilsp.query: Herr Wurtz, wenn Sie in diesem Zusammenhang die Grundrechtscharta und die hohen Prinzipien Europas zitieren, dann muss ich Sie darauf hinweisen, dass in dem Moment, als es um europäische Grundrechte ging, als es um ethnische Säuberungen, um Vertreibung und Terror auf dem Balkan ging, ihre politische Gruppierung abseits stand und versagt hat.
ilsp.judge: Mr. Wurtz, if you're going to cite the Charter of Fundamental Rights and the high principles of Europe in this context, I must point out that at the moment when it came to European human rights, when it came to ethnic cleansing, deportation, and terror on the Balkans, your political group stood aside and failed.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. Wurtz, if you quote the Charter of Fundamental Rights and the high principles of Europe in this context, then I must point out to you that at the moment when it came to European fundamental rights, when it came to ethnic cleansing, expulsion, and terror on the Balkans, your political group stood aside and failed.
ilsp.reference: Mr. Wurtz, if you cite the Charter of Fundamental Rights and the high principles of Europe in this context, then I must point out that when it came to European fundamental rights, when it came to ethnic cleansing, expulsion, and terror on the Balkan peninsula, your political group stood aside and failed.

ilsp.query: Folglich ist - und ich darf Ihnen sagen, dass es keine schädliche Substanz gibt, die selbst bei Aufnahme in kleinen Dosen keinen Schaden verursachen würde - eine akribische epidemiologische Studie erforderlich, sowohl im Golf als auch in Bosnien und selbstverständlich im Kosovo, obgleich die Folgen dort erst später spürbar werden.
ilsp.judge: Consequently - and I may say to you that there is no harmful substance that would not cause any harm even at intake in small doses - a meticulous epidemiological study is required, both in the Gulf and in Bosnia, and of course in Kosovo, although the consequences there will only be noticeable later.
ilsp.proxy: Consequently, and I must tell you that there is no harmful substance that would cause any harm even if taken in small doses - an accurate epidemiological study is required, both in the Gulf and in Bosnia and of course in Kosovo, although the consequences there will only become apparent later.

ilsp.query: Schließlich hätte ich gern gewusst, ob künftig noch Diskussionen mit dem Herrn Kommissar über eventuelle Einsatzszenarien möglich sind, denn jetzt reden wir theoretisch über Instrumente, wir müssen in Zukunft aber auch über die praktische Anwendung sprechen, und dafür dürfte eine Szenariendiskussion, so meine ich, überaus sinnvoll sein.
ilsp.judge: Finally, I would have liked to know if future discussions with the Commissioner about possible deployment scenarios are still possible, because we are now talking theoretically about instruments, but in the future we also have to talk about the practical application, and I think a scenario discussion would be extremely useful for that.
ilsp.proxy: Finally, I would like to know if future discussions with Commissioner Mr. about possible deployment scenarios are still possible, because now we are talking theoretically about instruments, but in the future we also have to talk about the practical application, and for that, I think, a scenario discussion would be very useful.
ilsp.reference: Finally, I would like to know if future discussions with Commissioner about potential deployment scenarios are still possible, because while we are currently talking theoretically about instruments, we will have to discuss their practical application in the future as well, and for that, I believe a scenario discussion would be highly worthwhile.

ilsp.query: Daher hätten wir eine umfassendere Finanzierung gewünscht, eine stärkere Koordinierung zur höheren Wirksamkeit der verschiedenen Programme, die angewendet werden können, sowie eine stärkere Mitverantwortung im Hinblick auf die spätere - manchmal leider notwendige - militärische Intervention, die möglicherweise nicht erforderlich wäre, wenn die vorangehenden Phasen realisiert würden.
ilsp.judge: Therefore, we would have wished for a more comprehensive financing, a stronger coordination for the higher effectiveness of the various programs that can be applied, as well as a stronger co-responsibility in view of the later - sometimes unfortunately necessary - military intervention, which might not be necessary if the preceding phases were realized.
ilsp.proxy: Therefore, we would have preferred a more comprehensive financing, a stronger coordination for higher effectiveness of the various programs that can be applied, as well as a stronger sense of responsibility in terms of the later - sometimes unfortunately necessary - military intervention, which might not be necessary if the preceding phases were realized.
ilsp.reference: Therefore, we would have preferred more comprehensive financing, stronger coordination for higher effectiveness of the various programs that can be applied, as well as greater shared responsibility regarding any subsequent - sometimes unfortunately necessary - military intervention, which might not be required if the preceding phases were realized.

ilsp.query: Hier geht es darum, eine Politik zu unterstützen, die Demokratie und Menschenrechte in Nordkorea ermöglicht und auf dieser Grundlage einen wesentlichen Beitrag dazu leistet, dass es eine zunehmende Verständigung zwischen den beiden Teilen Koreas gibt: Die hat nach dem Treffen der Präsidenten dazu geführt, dass man erstmals wieder über die Einheit dieses Landes debattiert.
ilsp.judge: It's about supporting a policy that enables democracy and human rights in North Korea and, on this basis, makes a significant contribution to increasing understanding between the two parts of Korea: This has led to the fact that, following the meeting of the presidents, the issue of the unity of this country is being debated for the first time again.
ilsp.proxy: This is about supporting a policy that enables democracy and human rights in North Korea and makes a significant contribution to increasing understanding between the two parts of Korea: This has led to the fact that for the first time again, the unity of this country is debated after the meeting of the presidents.
ilsp.reference: This is about supporting a policy that enables democracy and human rights in North Korea and contributes to increasing understanding between the two parts of Korea: This has led to debates about the unification of this country for the first time since the meeting of the presidents.

ilsp.query: Die nordkoreanischen Machthaber sind offenbar bereit zur Öffnung und zum Dialog mit Südkorea, den USA, Europa und Japan. Auch wenn wir sie letztlich nach ihren Taten beurteilen müssen, so bin ich doch überzeugt davon, dass eine europäische Politik des Dialogs, des strukturierten und kritischen Dialogs, in entscheidendem Maße zu einem Wandel in der Demokratische Volksrepublik Korea, der der ganzen Welt zugute kommt, beitragen wird.
ilsp.judge: The North Korean leaders appear to be ready for opening up and dialogue with South Korea, the US, Europe, and Japan. Even if we ultimately have to judge them by their actions, I am nonetheless convinced that a European policy of dialogue, of structured and critical dialogue, will contribute significantly to a change in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to the benefit of the whole world.
ilsp.proxy: The North Korean leaders seem to be ready for opening and dialogue with South Korea, the United States, Europe, and Japan. Even if we ultimately judge them by their actions, I am convinced that a European policy of dialogue, of structured and critical dialogue, will contribute in a decisive way to a change in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea that will benefit the whole world.
ilsp.reference: The North Korean rulers seem ready for openness and dialogue with South Korea, the United States, Europe, and Japan. While we ultimately must judge them by their actions, I am convinced that a European policy of dialogue, of structured and critical dialogue, will contribute significantly to a change in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea that benefits the entire world.

ilsp.query: Nordkorea hat Mühe, die wenigen und ohnehin symbolhaften Verpflichtungen, die es auf militärischem Gebiet übernommen hat, einzuhalten; es verzögert die Zusammenführung der seit dem Krieg in den 50er Jahren getrennten Familien und lässt durch nichts seinen Willen erkennen, den Gegenbesuch von Kim Jong Il in Seoul, der für das kommende Frühjahr vorgesehen war und von dem noch nicht bekannt ist, wann und ob er stattfinden wird, auch wirklich in die Tat umzusetzen.
ilsp.judge: North Korea is having trouble keeping up with the few and already symbolic commitments it has taken on in the military field; it is delaying the reunification of families separated since the war in the 1950s and shows no intention of actually carrying out the reciprocal visit of Kim Jong Il to Seoul, which was planned for the upcoming spring and whose date and whether it will take place are still unknown.
ilsp.proxy: North Korea has difficulty fulfilling the few and symbolic military obligations it has taken on; it delays the reunification of families separated since the war in the 1950s and shows no sign of implementing the planned visit of Kim Jong Il to Seoul, which was scheduled for the coming spring and whose date and whether it will actually take place is still unknown.
ilsp.reference: North Korea struggles to fulfill even the few, and anyway symbolic, military obligations it has taken on; it delays the reunification of families separated since the war in the 1950s and shows no willingness to follow through with Kim Jong Il's planned reciprocal visit to Seoul, which was scheduled for the coming spring and whose timing and whether it will take place are still unknown.

ilsp.query: Nichtsdestotrotz spüre ich eine gewisse Zuversicht und stelle fest, dass die EU-Staaten unkoordiniert angetreten sind - Herr Brok hat soeben davon gesprochen -, um die Anerkennung des stalinistischen Regimes von Pjöngjang zu wetteifern, wobei sie die Augen vor den Geschehnissen innerhalb des Landes, vor den dramatischen Menschenrechtsverletzungen, verschließen.
ilsp.judge: Despite this, I sense a certain optimism and I note that the EU member states have embarked on this uncoordinated - as Mr. Brok has just mentioned - competition to recognize the Stalinist regime in Pyongyang, while turning a blind eye to the events within the country, to the dramatic human rights abuses.
ilsp.proxy: Nevertheless, I feel a certain sense of optimism and note that the EU states have acted uncoordinated - Mr. Brok just mentioned this - to compete for the recognition of the Stalinist regime in Pyongyang, while they turn a blind eye to the events within the country, to the dramatic human rights violations.
ilsp.reference: Nevertheless, I feel a certain optimism and note that the EU states have acted uncoordinatedly – as Mr. Brok just mentioned – in competing for recognition of the Stalinist regime in Pyongyang, while turning a blind eye to the events within the country, including the dramatic human rights violations.

ilsp.query: Deshalb sage ich: Selbstverständlich fördern wir die Annäherung zwischen den beiden koreanischen Staaten, selbstverständlich unterstützen wir die Nordkoreaner, damit sie nicht hungers sterben - der Kollege Ford hat soeben davon gesprochen -, doch stellen wir hierfür harte Bedingungen, um zu gewährleisten, dass die Hilfe auch bei denjenigen, die sie wirklich benötigen, ankommt und wir nicht ein paranoides und unberechenbares Regime unterstützen, das daran gewöhnt ist, uns mit Nuklearwaffen und Raketen zu erpressen, um sein Überleben zu sichern.
ilsp.judge: That's why I say: Of course, we promote the rapprochement between the two Korean states, of course, we support the North Koreans so that they do not starve to death - colleague Ford just spoke about this - but we set tough conditions for this to ensure that the help reaches those who really need it and we do not support a paranoid and unpredictable regime that is accustomed to blackmailing us with nuclear weapons and missiles to secure its survival.
ilsp.proxy: That's why I say: Of course we support the rapprochement between the two Korean states, of course we support the North Koreans so that they do not starve to death - the colleague Ford just spoke about that - but we set hard conditions for this to ensure that the aid reaches those who really need it and we do not support a paranoid and unpredictable regime that is accustomed to blackmailing us with nuclear weapons and missiles to secure its survival.
ilsp.reference: Therefore, I say: Of course, we promote the rapprochement between the two Korean states, and of course, we support the North Koreans so they do not starve to death - as my colleague Ford just mentioned - but we set hard conditions for this to ensure that aid reaches those who truly need it and we do not support a paranoid and unpredictable regime that is accustomed to using nuclear weapons and missiles to extort us in order to secure its survival.

ilsp.query: Eben weil die Union diese Unklarheiten bewusst bestehen lässt, haben einige Länder Schwierigkeiten mit der Veröffentlichung ihrer Listen für "Natura 2000 " und mit der sachorientierten Umsetzung der Habitat-Richtlinie ohne Widerstand vonseiten ihrer Landwirte, wobei die hohen Ziele dieser Richtlinie allgemein anerkannt werden.

ilsp.query: Also habe ich mir gesagt: "Wenn über den Bericht Van den Bos abgestimmt wird, dann stimme mit Ja - erinnere Dich daran, Fatuzzo -, aber weise auch darauf hin, dass es angebracht wäre, darauf Acht zu geben und zu kontrollieren, dass die aufgrund dieses Abkommens der Bevölkerung von Bangladesch gewährten Beihilfen auch dazu verwendet werden, damit der Staat einigen älteren Menschen eine Rente bewilligt. "
ilsp.judge: I also thought to myself: "When Van den Bos' report is voted on, then vote yes - remember Fatuzzo - but also point out that it would be advisable to pay attention to and ensure that the assistance granted to the people of Bangladesh under this agreement is also used to allow the state to grant a pension to some older people."
