ilsp.query: Unter diesen Umständen dient die vorgeschlagene Bereitstellung von EU-Mitteln im Wesentlichen dazu, das Versagen des Staates in diesem Land auszugleichen und den europäischen Institutionen die Kosten für die von den großen Konzernen benötigten Infrastrukturen aufzubürden, um letzteren die Möglichkeit zu geben, aus einer der weltweit ärmsten Bevölkerungen den größtmöglichen Gewinn zu ziehen.
ilsp.judge: Under these circumstances, the proposed allocation of EU funds essentially serves to offset the failure of the state in this country and to burden European institutions with the costs of the infrastructure required by the large corporations, thereby giving them the opportunity to reap the greatest possible profit from one of the world's poorest populations.
ilsp.proxy: Under these circumstances, the proposed provision of EU funds essentially serves to compensate for the failure of the state in this country and to burden the European institutions with the costs of the infrastructure required by the large corporations, so that the latter can extract the maximum profit from one of the poorest populations in the world.
ilsp.reference: Under these circumstances, the proposed provision of EU funds essentially serves to compensate for the failure of the state in this country and to shift the costs for the infrastructure required by large corporations onto the European institutions, thereby allowing them to maximize profit from one of the world's poorest populations.

ilsp.query: . Der Bericht über die Situation der Grenzarbeitnehmer, den unser Ausschuss für Beschäftigung und soziale Angelegenheiten uns vorgelegt hat, basiert sicher auf der lobenswerten Absicht, die Grenzarbeiter, was ihre Lohn- und Arbeitsbedingungen und ihre soziale Sicherheit betrifft, nicht zu diskriminieren und diesbezüglich noch bestehende Probleme zu lösen.
ilsp.judge: The report on the situation of border workers presented to us by our Committee on Employment and Social Affairs is likely based on the praiseworthy intention not to discriminate against border workers, in terms of their remuneration and working conditions, and their social security, and to solve any existing problems in this regard.
ilsp.proxy: The report on the situation of border workers, which our Committee on Employment and Social Affairs has presented to us, is certainly based on the laudable intention of not discriminating against border workers in terms of their working and living conditions and their social security, and of solving existing problems in this regard.
ilsp.reference: The report on the situation of border workers, which our Committee on Employment and Social Affairs has presented to us, undoubtedly stems from the praiseworthy intention of not discriminating against border workers regarding their working and wage conditions and social security, and of addressing any existing issues in this regard.

ilsp.query: Wir müssen, auch in der Welthandelsorganisation, die Ursprungsbezeichnungen unserer Qualitätsprodukte, u. a. des Weins, verteidigen und sichern, denn unsere Zukunft in der EU und was den Export in Drittländer betrifft, liegt in Produkten hochwertiger Qualität, für die es bei uns, und auch in der Welt, zahlungskräftige und mündige Verbraucher gibt.
ilsp.judge: We must, also within the World Trade Organization, defend and secure the origin designations of our high-quality products, including wine, as our future in the EU and with regard to exports to third countries depends on products of superior quality, for which there are price-paying and informed consumers both at home and around the world.
ilsp.proxy: We must also defend and secure the origin designations of our quality products, including wine, in the World Trade Organization, because our future in the EU and what concerns exports to third countries lies in high-quality products for which there are paying and discerning consumers both here and in the world.
ilsp.reference: We must defend and secure the origin designations of our quality products, including wine, in the World Trade Organization, as our future in the EU and for exports to third countries lies in high-quality products for which there are financially sound and discerning consumers both here and around the world.

ilsp.query: Die Kommission führt folgende Prioritäten auf: verbesserte Kohärenz zwischen den verschiedenen Zielen, die die GFP verfolgt, insbesondere zwischen Erhaltung der Ressourcen, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Arbeitsplatzsicherung in den von der Fischerei abhängigen Gebieten; stärkere Berücksichtigung der wirtschaftlichen Dimension des Fischereisektors; verbesserte Integration der Umwelt- und Fischereipolitik; Verbesserung der Bewirtschaftungsinstrumente, wie insbesondere die Einbeziehung der mehrjährigen Bewirtschaftungsziele; ein übersichtlicherer Entscheidungsfindungsprozess und die Erhaltung der externen Dimension der GFP.
ilsp.judge: The Commission sets the following priorities: improved coherence between the various objectives pursued by the GFP, in particular between the conservation of resources, economic viability and job security in the areas dependent on fishing; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fishing sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policy; improvement of management instruments, including in particular the inclusion of multi-annual management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the GFP.
ilsp.proxy: The Commission lists the following priorities: improved coherence between the various objectives pursued by the GFP, in particular between the conservation of resources, economic viability and job security in the fishing-dependent areas; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fishing sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policy; improvement of management instruments, in particular the inclusion of multiannual management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the GFP.
ilsp.reference: The Commission lists the following priorities: improved coherence between the various goals pursued by the GFP, especially between resource conservation, economic viability, and job security in fishing-dependent areas; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fisheries sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policies; better management tools, particularly the inclusion of multi-year management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process; and the maintenance of the external dimension of the GFP.

ilsp.query: Das Europäische Parlament hat sich natürlich konsequent gegenüber sich selbst verhalten, denn - wie der Kriegsverbrecher und ehemalige NATO-Generalsekretär sowie jetzige Hohe Vertreter der EU, Javier Solana, in zynischen Worten in seiner Ansprache hervorhob - das Europäische Parlament hat selbst beharrlich die militärische Intervention auf dem Balkan, sowohl in Bosnien als auch im Kosovo, gefordert.
ilsp.judge: The European Parliament has naturally acted consistently against itself, for - as the war criminal and former NATO Secretary-General as well as current EU High Representative, Javier Solana, pointed out in cynical words in his address - the European Parliament itself has persistently demanded military intervention in the Balkans, both in Bosnia and in Kosovo.
ilsp.proxy: The European Parliament has, of course, consistently behaved towards itself, because - as the war criminal and former NATO Secretary-General and now High Representative of the EU, Javier Solana, pointed out in his speech in cynical words - the European Parliament has consistently demanded military intervention on the Balkans, both in Bosnia and in Kosovo.
ilsp.reference: The European Parliament has, of course, consistently held itself to this standard, as the war criminal and former NATO Secretary-General, currently the High Representative of the EU, Javier Solana, emphasized in his cynical words during his speech: the European Parliament itself persistently called for military intervention on the Balkans, both in Bosnia and Kosovo.

ilsp.query: . (FR) Dass den Armeen der größten Mächte seit zehn Jahren die Schädlichkeit von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran, auch für diejenigen, die sie einsetzen, bekannt ist, beweist nur, dass die Generalstäbe ihren eigenen Soldaten die gleiche Missachtung entgegenbringen wie der Zivilbevölkerung und den gegnerischen Streitkräften.
ilsp.judge: That the armies of the greatest powers have known for ten years the harmfulness of uranium-tipped ammunition, even for those who use it, proves only that the general staffs show the same contempt to their own soldiers as to the civilian population and the opposing forces.
ilsp.proxy: . (FR) That the armies of the great powers have known for ten years the harmfulness of depleted uranium ammunition, also for those who use it, only proves that the general staffs treat their own soldiers the same disrespect as the civilian population and the enemy forces.
ilsp.reference: The fact that the armies of the great powers have known for ten years about the harmfulness of ammunition containing depleted uranium, not just for those who use it, proves that the general staffs treat their own soldiers with the same disregard as they do the civilian population and the opposing forces.

ilsp.query: Seit Beginn des Atomzeitalters mit dem Zweiten Weltkrieg sind die Gefahren und Vorsorgemaßnahmen wohl bekannt, die man beim Umgang mit Uran und anderen radioaktiven Stoffen beachten muss, weil es sich um ein hochtoxisches (chemisch und radiologisch toxisches) Element handelt, wenn man es einatmet oder aufnimmt, das auch genetisch gefährlich ist.
ilsp.judge: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and preventive measures are well known that one must observe when handling uranium and other radioactive substances, because it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that is also genetically hazardous if inhaled or ingested.
ilsp.proxy: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and precautions to be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive substances are well known, because it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element if it is inhaled or ingested, which is also genetically dangerous.
ilsp.reference: Since the beginning of the atomic age, starting with World War II, the dangers and precautionary measures that must be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive substances are well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that can be hazardous to genetic material if inhaled or ingested.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, nach all den tragischen Geschehnissen im Zusammenhang mit der Bombardierung Jugoslawiens und nach den Enthüllungen über die Verwendung von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran ist es nunmehr dringend erforderlich, diese Art von Waffen zu verbieten, die selbst nach ihrem Einsatz noch über eine lange Zeit hinweg gefährliche Auswirkungen haben und blind, d. h. ohne erkennbaren Unterschied, all diejenigen treffen können, die Gefahr laufen, mit ihnen in Berührung zu kommen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, in light of the tragic events surrounding the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of depleted uranium ammunition, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which, even after its use, has hazardous effects for a long time and can, blind, i.e., without discernible distinction, affect all those who run the risk of coming into contact with them.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, after all the tragic events in connection with the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of depleted uranium ammunition, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which can have dangerous effects for a long time even after their use and can hit all those who run the risk of coming into contact with them, blind, that is, without any discernible difference.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, following all the tragic events in connection with the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of munitions with depleted uranium, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which continues to have dangerous effects for a long time after its use and can affect indiscriminately, that is, without any discernible distinction, all those who are at risk of coming into contact with them.

ilsp.query: Abschließend möchte ich meine Ratlosigkeit angesichts der politischen Kehrtwende zum Ausdruck bringen, die bei unserer Aussprache zutage getreten ist. Während uns seinerzeit einige vorhielten, unsere Kritik an Milosevics Politik diene der NATO und ihren Bombardements, wirft uns Herr Solana heute vor, wir würden bei unseren Vorbehalten gegenüber dem abgereicherten Uran die Menschenrechte der Opfer von Milosevic vergessen.
ilsp.judge: In conclusion, I would like to express my bewilderment in the face of the political U-turn that has become apparent in our discussion. While some of us were accused at the time of using our criticism of Milosevic's policy to serve the interests of NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic in our reservations about the enriched uranium.
ilsp.proxy: In conclusion, I would like to express my bewilderment at the political U-turn that has emerged during our discussion. While some of us were once criticized for our criticism of Milosevic's policy, which served the NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana accuses us today of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic by our reservations about the depleted uranium.
ilsp.reference: In conclusion, I want to express my helplessness regarding the political about-face that has become apparent during our discussion. While some had previously argued that our criticism of Milosevic's politics served the NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic when we harbor reservations about depleted uranium.

ilsp.query: Ich habe im letzten Jahr außerdem mit Sorge beobachtet, dass die derzeitige russische Führung - zu der viele ehemalige KGB-Mitarbeiter gehören, die von Präsident Putin, der ja früher selbst KGB-Oberst war, berufen wurden - großen Eifer bei der Verhaftung so genannter britischer, amerikanischer und russischer Spione an den Tag gelegt hat.
ilsp.judge: I have also been observing with concern in the past year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees who were appointed by President Putin, who was himself a KGB colonel in the past - has shown great zeal in the arrest of so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
ilsp.proxy: I also observed with concern last year that the current Russian leadership - many of whom are former KGB employees who were appointed by President Putin, who himself was a KGB colonel - has shown great enthusiasm in the arrest of so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
ilsp.reference: In the past year, I have also observed with concern that the current Russian leadership - many of whom are former KGB employees appointed by President Putin, who himself used to be a KGB Colonel - has shown great zeal in arresting so-called British, American, and Russian spies.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Vitorino, Herr Ratspräsident, wenn wir eine Entscheidung über ein Thema wie die Menschenrechte treffen sollen, haben wir zwei Möglichkeiten: Wir können Prinzipien nennen und auf die Benennung von Gebieten verzichten, oder wir können so vorgehen, wie wir es getan haben, nämlich Gebiete benennen und dabei das Risiko eingehen, dass man einige vergisst.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Vitorino, Mr. President of the Council, if we are to make a decision on a topic such as human rights, we have two options: we can name principles and forego the naming of areas, or we can proceed as we have done, namely name areas and thereby take the risk that some may be forgotten.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, Mr. Vitorino, Mr. Council President, if we are to make a decision on a matter like human rights, we have two options: We can name principles and avoid naming areas, or we can proceed as we have done, namely to name areas and take the risk that some will be forgotten.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, Mr. Vitorino, Mr. Council President, if we are to make a decision on a topic like human rights, we have two options: We can name principles and avoid naming areas, or we can proceed as we have done, namely by naming areas and thereby taking the risk that some will be forgotten.

ilsp.query: Ich sage das eingedenk des Völkermords in Ruanda im Jahre 1994, wo die Völkergemeinschaft mit ansehen musste, wie Hunderttausende Menschen ermordet wurden. Im Hinblick auf Zentralafrika möchte ich darauf drängen, dass die Europäische Union energischer handelt und auch die Vereinten Nationen größere Wachsamkeit zeigen.
ilsp.judge: I say this mindful of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to witness the murder of hundreds of thousands of people. In light of Central Africa, I would like to urge that the European Union takes more decisive action and that the United Nations displays greater vigilance.
ilsp.proxy: I say this in memory of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to watch as hundreds of thousands of people were murdered. In the context of Central Africa, I urge the European Union to act more decisively and also for the United Nations to show greater vigilance.
ilsp.reference: I say this in remembrance of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to watch as hundreds of thousands of people were murdered. Regarding Central Africa, I urge that the European Union take more decisive action and that the United Nations also show greater vigilance.

ilsp.query: Zum Beispiel zeichnet Schweden seit vielen Jahren auf der Vollversammlung der UN für eine Resolution zur Lage in Birma/Myanmar verantwortlich und die Union ist im Hinblick auf die Tatsache, dass es in Birma immer noch Zwangsarbeit gibt, als Ganzes aktiv an Gesprächen im Rahmen der Internationalen Arbeitsorganisation, ILO, engagiert.
ilsp.judge: For example, Sweden has been responsible for a resolution on the situation in Burma/Myanmar at the UN General Assembly for many years, and the Union is actively engaged in talks within the framework of the International Labour Organization, ILO, taking into account the fact that forced labour still exists in Burma.
ilsp.proxy: For example, Sweden has been responsible for a resolution on the situation in Burma/Myanmar at the UN General Assembly for many years, and the Union is actively engaged in talks within the International Labour Organization, ILO, with regard to the fact that there is still forced labor in Burma.
ilsp.reference: For example, Sweden has been advocating for a resolution on the situation in Burma/Myanmar at the UN General Assembly for many years, and the union is actively engaged in discussions within the framework of the International Labour Organization (ILO), taking into account the fact that forced labor still exists in Burma.

ilsp.query: (Beifall) Zweitens: Wir fordern Sie auf, schon ziemlich schnell - die Vorbereitungen müssen unter Ihrer Präsidentschaft beginnen und sollten dann in Laken unter belgischer Präsidentschaft zu einem Beschluss führen - eine Konferenz einzusetzen, die sich an der Methodik und an dem Modell des Konventes orientiert, unter starker Beteiligung des Europäischen Parlaments und natürlich der nationalen Regierungen, vor allen Dingen aber auch der Kommission.
ilsp.judge: (Applause) Secondly, we call on you to start preparations quite quickly - under your presidency, they should lead to a decision in Laken under Belgian presidency - to convene a conference that is oriented towards the methodology and model of the Convention, with strong participation of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, above all, however, also the Commission.
ilsp.proxy: (Applause) Secondly: We call on you to start preparing this as soon as possible - the preparations must begin under your presidency and should then lead to a decision in Luxembourg under Belgian presidency - to set up a conference that is oriented towards the method and model of the convention, with strong involvement of the European Parliament and of course the national governments, but above all also of the Commission.
ilsp.reference: (Applause) Second: We urge you to start making preparations quite swiftly – these must begin under your presidency and should then lead to a decision in Laeken under the Belgian presidency – by convening a conference that is oriented towards the method and model of the Convention, with strong involvement of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, but especially also of the Commission.

ilsp.query: Schweden übernimmt zum ersten Mal den Ratsvorsitz und hat seine Prioritäten gesetzt, die berühmten 3 "E ", die mit dem Manifest der europäischen Sozialisten und Sozialdemokraten übereinstimmen, weil ich stolz sagen kann, dass Herr Persson und seine Partei zu meiner politischen Familie gehören, und der Ministerpräsident Schwedens hier darüber hinaus eine Verteidigung des europäischen Sozialmodells und seiner Anpassungsfähigkeit in Zeiten der Globalisierung vorgenommen hat, die uns mit Stolz erfüllt.
ilsp.judge: Sweden takes over the presidency for the first time and has set its priorities, the famous 3 "E's", which align with the Manifesto of European Socialists and Social Democrats, because I am proud to say that Mr. Persson and his party belong to my political family, and the Prime Minister of Sweden has, in addition, made a defence of the European Social Model and its adaptability in times of Globalization, which fills us with pride.
ilsp.proxy: Sweden takes over the presidency for the first time and has set its priorities, the famous 3 "E", which coincide with the Manifesto of the European Socialists and Social Democrats, because I can proudly say that Mr. Persson and his party belong to my political family, and the Prime Minister of Sweden has also made a defense of the European social model and its adaptability in times of globalization, which fills us with pride.
ilsp.reference: Sweden is taking on the presidency for the first time and has set its priorities, which align with the famous 3 "E's" from the Manifesto of European Socialists and Social Democrats, because I can proudly say that Mr. Persson and his party belong to my political family, and the Swedish Prime Minister has also defended the European social model and its adaptability in times of globalization, which fills us with pride.

ilsp.query: In einer ersten Phase müsste parallel zu der unter schwedischer Präsidentschaft begonnenen Diskussion auf Einladung des Europäischen Rates - und zwar frühestmöglich - eine Diskussion und Meinungsbildung auf der Ebene der nationalen Parlamente stattfinden, die dann ebenso wie das Europäische Parlament jeweils bis etwa Frühjahr 2002 einen Vorschlag hinsichtlich dieser Kompetenzabgrenzung vorlegen müssten.
ilsp.judge: In an initial phase, a discussion and opinion-forming process should take place at the level of national parliaments, parallel to the ongoing discussion under Swedish presidency, which was initiated by the European Council - as soon as possible. Each national parliament, as well as the European Parliament, would then have to submit a proposal regarding this competence division by approximately spring 2002.
ilsp.proxy: In a first phase, a discussion and opinion formation at the level of national parliaments should take place in parallel to the discussion initiated by the Swedish presidency - and as soon as possible - which would then, like the European Parliament, each submit a proposal on this competence delimitation by about spring 2002.
ilsp.reference: In the first phase, parallel to the discussion initiated by the Swedish Presidency at the invitation of the European Council - and as soon as possible - a discussion and opinion-forming process should take place at the level of national parliaments, which would then, like the European Parliament, have to present proposals regarding this competence delimitation by early spring 2002.

ilsp.query: Deshalb beruhigt uns das Angebot zur Mitwirkung, das Sie heute diesem Parlament unterbreitet haben, vor allem mit Blick auf Ihre Erklärungen, auf die sich Herr Poettering kurz zuvor bezog und die anscheinend darauf hinausliefen, dass die Kommission eine Institution sei, die an einem großen demokratischen Defizit leide, und dieses Parlament nach den Wahlen von 1999 und der niedrigen Wahlbeteiligung der Bürger Ihres Landes aufgelöst werden sollte.
ilsp.judge: That's why we are reassured by the offer of cooperation that you have presented to this parliament today, especially in light of your statements to which Mr. Poettering referred just beforehand, and which apparently led to the conclusion that the Commission is an institution suffering from a major democratic deficit, and that this parliament should be dissolved after the 1999 elections and the low voter turnout of the citizens of your country.
ilsp.proxy: That is why we are reassured by the offer of cooperation that you have made to this Parliament today, especially in the light of your statements, to which Mr Poettering referred just now and which seemed to lead to the conclusion that the Commission was an institution suffering from a large democratic deficit and that this Parliament should be dissolved after the elections of 1999 and the low voter turnout in your country.
ilsp.reference: That is why we are reassured by the offer of cooperation you have presented to this Parliament today, especially in light of your statements that Mr. Poettering referred to just moments ago, which seemed to suggest that the Commission was an institution suffering from a significant democratic deficit, and that this Parliament should be dissolved following the elections of 1999 and low voter turnout in your country.

ilsp.query: Ebenso wie einige andere Redner des heutigen Tages bin auch ich beunruhigt über die Tendenz, das zwischenstaatliche Modell oft und nachdrücklich auf Kosten des so genannten Community Approach hervorzuheben, der der Kommission eine stärkere Rolle und Bedeutung zuweist.
ilsp.judge: Just like some other speakers of today, I am also concerned about the trend of often and emphatically highlighting the inter-state model at the expense of what is called the Community Approach, which assigns a stronger role and significance to the Commission.
ilsp.proxy: Like some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to often and emphatically highlight the inter-state model at the expense of the so-called Community Approach, which gives the Commission a stronger role and significance.
ilsp.reference: Similarly to some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to often and emphatically highlight the intergovernmental model at the expense of what is known as the Community Approach, which assigns the Commission a stronger role and significance.

ilsp.query: Wenn es Ihnen gelingt, Ihre Landsleute davon zu überzeugen, dass der Euro ein gutes Projekt ist, dass er nach innen stabil ist, dass seine Stabilität nach außen auch immer besser wird, wenn Sie sie davon überzeugen können, dieses große Werk der europäischen Integration mitzutragen, tragen Sie damit auch dazu bei, dass dieser Bereich der Europäischen Union auch von den Bürgern besser verstanden werden kann.
ilsp.judge: If you succeed in convincing your fellow countrymen that the Euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its stability will also improve externally, and if you can convince them to contribute to this great work of European integration, you will also contribute to the fact that this area of the European Union can be better understood by its citizens.
ilsp.proxy: If you can convince your fellow citizens that the euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, and that its stability is also getting better externally, if you can convince them to contribute to this great work of European integration, you will also contribute to the fact that this area of the European Union is better understood by the citizens.
ilsp.reference: If you manage to convince your fellow citizens that the Euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, and that its stability is getting better externally over time, and if you can persuade them to contribute to this great work of European integration, then you will also help to ensure that this area of the European Union is better understood by its citizens.

ilsp.query: Gleichzeitig verkündet der Europarat, dass die Folter weiterhin in den Polizeirevieren der Türkei an der Tagesordnung ist, und Amnesty International verurteilt die Folter, die Nichtbestrafung der Verantwortlichen und generell die Verstöße gegen die Menschenrechte seitens der Türkei und fordert die Europäische Union auf, zu verlangen, dass die Folter unverzüglich eingestellt wird, und nicht erst 2002­2003, wie in dem Verfahren für den Beitritt der Türkei zur Europäischen Union vorgesehen.
ilsp.judge:
# English
At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture is still on the agenda in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the non-prosecution of those responsible, and generally the human rights violations by Turkey, and demands that the European Union call for torture to be immediately stopped, and not just in 2002-2003, as provided for in the accession procedure for Turkey's entry into the European Union.
ilsp.proxy: At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture continues to be practiced in the police stations of Turkey, and Amnesty International condemns torture, the impunity of the perpetrators, and generally the violations of human rights by Turkey, and calls on the European Union to demand that torture be immediately stopped, and not only in 2002-2003, as provided for in the accession process of Turkey to the European Union.
ilsp.reference: Simultaneously, the Council of Europe announces that torture continues to be practiced in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the impunity of those responsible, and generally the human rights violations by Turkey, calling on the European Union to demand an immediate end to torture, rather than in 2002-2003 as planned in the accession process for Turkey's membership in the European Union.

ilsp.query: Deshalb sage ich auch sehr deutlich: So sehr wir in weiten Teilen Ihrem Bericht zustimmen können, halten wir es nicht für angemessen, dass das Parlament in bestimmten Bereichen - Stichwort "alleiniger Flugbegleiter " oder die Dauer der Beschäftigung, also wie lange jemand bereits als Flugbegleiter tätig ist - eigene detaillierte Grundlagen in diese Verordnung einsetzt.
ilsp.judge: Therefore, I say very clearly: As much as we can agree with your report in many parts, we do not consider it appropriate that the parliament introduces its own detailed foundations in certain areas - the term "sole flight attendant" or the duration of employment, i.e., how long someone has already been working as a flight attendant - into this regulation.
ilsp.proxy: That's why I also say very clearly: Although we agree with the report in many parts, we do not consider it appropriate that the Parliament sets its own detailed foundations in certain areas - the keyword "single flight attendant" or the duration of employment, i.e. how long someone has already been a flight attendant - in this regulation.
ilsp.reference: That is why I also state very clearly: While we can agree with much of your report, we do not consider it appropriate for the Parliament to set its own detailed grounds in certain areas - such as the term "sole flight attendant" or the duration of employment, i.e., how long someone has already been working as a flight attendant - into this regulation.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson, Frau Kommissarin! Nachdem ich soeben die Nachrichten gesehen hatte, hoffte ich - und eigentlich sah es auch fast danach aus -, wir würden eine Aussprache über fox hunting führen, worüber es heute Abend zweifellos eine äußerst lebhafte Debatte im britischen Parlament geben wird.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson, Commissioner! After I had just seen the news, I had hoped - and it actually seemed almost like it - that we would have a discussion about fox hunting, which will undoubtedly lead to a very lively debate in the British Parliament tonight.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson, Mrs. Commissioner! After I just saw the news, I hoped - and actually it looked like that too - that we would have a debate on fox hunting, which will certainly be a very lively debate in the British Parliament tonight.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson, Mrs. Commissioner! After just watching the news, I hoped – and it actually seemed that way – that we would have a discussion about fox hunting, which will undoubtedly lead to a very lively debate in the British Parliament this evening.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson hat wirklich einen ausgezeichneten Bericht vorgelegt. Ich kann das behaupten, weil ich wohl zu den wenigen gehöre, die nicht nur politisch, sondern auch fachlich mit diesem Sektor vertraut sind, denn bevor ich mich meiner Tätigkeit als Abgeordneter dieses Parlaments zuwandte, hatte ich etwa 10 000 Flugstunden als Mitglied einer Cockpitbesatzung absolviert.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has really presented an excellent report. I can say that because I probably belong to the few who are not only politically but also professionally familiar with this sector, because before I turned to my activity as a member of this parliament, I had about 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has really presented an excellent report. I can say that because I am one of the few who not only politically but also professionally are familiar with this sector, because before I turned to my work as a Member of this Parliament, I had about 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has indeed presented an excellent report. I can say this because I am one of the few who are not only politically but also professionally familiar with this sector, as before I devoted myself to my work as a Member of this Parliament, I had accumulated approximately 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.

ilsp.query: Ich weise Sie darauf hin, dass die Sicherheit das A und O des Luftverkehrs ist, wobei zu beachten ist, dass diese Sicherheit auf zwei Faktoren beruht: zum einen auf dem technischen Faktor, das heißt den Ausrüstungen, Flugzeugen, Flughäfen, Funknavigations- und Flugleiteinrichtungen usw., und zum anderen auf dem äußerst bedeutsamen menschlichen Faktor, der zwar keinen entscheidenden, aber doch einen sehr hohen Anteil an den Flugzeugunglücken hat.
ilsp.judge: I would like to draw your attention to the fact that safety is the A and O of air traffic, where it is worth noting that this safety is based on two factors: on the one hand, the technical factor, that is to say the equipment, aircraft, airports, navigation and air traffic control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, although it does not have a decisive share, yet has a very high share in aircraft accidents.
ilsp.proxy: I draw your attention to the fact that safety is the overriding concern of air traffic, which must be borne in mind, since safety depends on two factors: on the technical factor, that is to say, the equipment, aircraft, airports, radio navigation and air traffic control installations, etc., and on the extremely important human factor, which, although it does not play a decisive role, does play a very high part in aircraft accidents.
ilsp.reference: I draw your attention to the fact that safety is the paramount concern in air traffic, with two factors being crucial for this safety: on one hand, the technical factor, which includes equipment, aircraft, airports, radio navigation and control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, although not decisive, still plays a very high role in aircraft accidents.

ilsp.query: Entweder einigen sich die Parteien bis zum Mai, oder wir erwarten, dass die Kommission einen Vorschlag macht, den wir in die zweite Lesung einbauen können, denn es geht nicht an, dass die entscheidende Frage für die Sicherheit der Passagiere, nämlich, ob die Kapitäne, die Besatzungen, so ausgeruht sind, dass sie ihre Aufgaben wahrnehmen können, nicht geregelt wird.
ilsp.judge: Either the parties will agree by May, or we expect the commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it's not acceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether the captains and crews are so well-rested that they can perform their duties, is not regulated.
ilsp.proxy: Either the parties agree by May, or we expect that the Commission will make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it is not acceptable that the decisive question for the safety of passengers, namely, whether the captains, the crews, are sufficiently rested to perform their duties, is not regulated.
ilsp.reference: Either the parties reach an agreement by May, or we expect the Commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, as it is unacceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether the captains and crew are sufficiently rested to perform their duties, remains unresolved.

ilsp.query: Davon ausgehend verfolgt die von uns vorgeschlagene Änderung zur bestehenden Verordnung ein zweifaches Ziel: Zum einen zielt sie auf die weitere Harmonisierung des Regulierungssystems im Bereich der Sicherheit der Zivilluftfahrt durch seine Ausdehnung auf die Harmonisierung der Betriebsanforderungen für Luftfahrzeuge; zum anderen geht es um die Festlegung von Verfahren, die es der Gemeinschaft ermöglichen, die Varianten und die Ausnahmen zu bearbeiten, die die Mitgliedstaaten hin und wieder aus operativen Erfordernissen anwenden müssen.
ilsp.judge:
# English
Starting from this, the proposed amendment to the existing regulation pursues a twofold objective: On the one hand, it aims at further harmonization of the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety through its extension to the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that enable the community to handle the variants and exceptions that Member States occasionally have to apply from operational requirements.
ilsp.proxy: Based on this, the proposed amendment to the existing regulation aims at achieving a twofold objective: On the one hand, it aims at further harmonizing the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it aims at defining procedures that will enable the Community to deal with the variations and exceptions that Member States have to apply from time to time for operational reasons.
ilsp.reference: Based on this, our proposed amendment to the existing regulation aims at achieving a dual objective: on the one hand, it seeks to further harmonize the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to include the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it focuses on establishing procedures that will enable the community to address the variations and exceptions that member states must occasionally apply due to operational necessities.

ilsp.query: Hinsichtlich des konkreten Problems der Thrombose - die jemand von Ihnen angesprochen hat - hat die Kommission die Luftverkehrsgesellschaften schriftlich aufgefordert, die Fluggäste über die Gefahren, Prädispositionsfaktoren und die Maßnahmen zur Minimierung dieser Risiken, konkret im Zusammenhang mit der Thrombose und den gesundheitlichen Problemen im Allgemeinen zu informieren.
ilsp.judge: Regarding the specific issue of thrombosis, which was brought up by someone of you, the Commission has formally requested the airlines to inform passengers in writing about the dangers, predisposing factors, and measures to minimize these risks, specifically in relation to thrombosis and general health problems.
ilsp.proxy: Regarding the specific problem of thrombosis - which someone of you has mentioned - the Commission has written to the air transport companies to inform passengers about the dangers, predisposing factors, and measures to minimize these risks, specifically in relation to thrombosis and general health problems.
ilsp.reference: Regarding the specific issue of thrombosis - which someone mentioned - the Commission has written to airlines to inform passengers about the dangers, predisposing factors, and measures to minimize these risks, specifically in the context of thrombosis and general health issues.

ilsp.query: Schaffen wir Vorschriften, suchen wir nach einem größeren Harmonisierungsgrad, fördern wir Maßnahmen, um den Fußgänger- und Fahrradverkehr vernünftig und sicher zu gestalten, und suchen wir nach Formeln zur Reduzierung des Schwerlastverkehrs, zumindest in den Ortschaften; harmonisieren wir die Geschwindigkeitsbeschränkungen durch einen ambitiösen Rechtsrahmen, wie von der Kommission 1986 vorgeschlagen wurde, indem wir die Mitgliedstaaten aus ihrer Trägheit wecken.
ilsp.judge: Let's create regulations, seek a higher degree of harmonization, promote measures to reasonably and safely arrange pedestrian and bicycle traffic, and seek formulas to reduce heavy traffic, at least in local communities; harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legislative framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking the member states from their lethargy.
ilsp.proxy: Let's create regulations, seek a greater degree of harmonization, promote measures to shape pedestrian and bicycle traffic reasonably and safely, and seek formulas to reduce heavy truck traffic, at least in the towns; harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking up the Member States from their inertia.
ilsp.reference: Let us create regulations, seek a greater degree of harmonization, promote measures to design pedestrian and bicycle traffic reasonably and safely, and look for formulas to reduce heavy goods vehicle traffic, at least in urban areas; harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking up the Member States from their inertia.

ilsp.query: Aus diesem Grunde bedaure ich auch außerordentlich, dass der Änderungsantrag zur Harmonisierung der Wiederzulassung verunfallter Fahrzeuge in der Europäischen Union nicht angenommen wurde, obwohl unabhängige Gutachten eindeutig einen substantiellen Zusammenhang zwischen einmal verunfallten Fahrzeugen und erneuter Teilhabe an Unfällen mit erhöhter Todesfolge beweisen.
ilsp.judge: I deeply regret, for this reason, that the amendment proposal for harmonizing the re-licensing of accident-damaged vehicles in the European Union was not accepted, although independent expert reports clearly prove a substantial link between vehicles that have been involved in an accident once and their subsequent involvement in further accidents with increased fatality.
ilsp.proxy: For this reason, I also regret very much that the amendment to harmonize the re-registration of accident vehicles in the European Union was not adopted, although independent reports clearly demonstrate a substantial link between once accident vehicles and increased risk of death in subsequent accidents.
ilsp.reference: For this reason, I regret very much that the amendment proposal for harmonizing the re-registration of accident-damaged vehicles in the European Union was not adopted, despite independent assessments clearly establishing a substantial connection between accident-damaged vehicles and increased fatality rates in subsequent accidents.

ilsp.query: Was nützt das Bedauern darüber, dass 95 % der Verkehrsunfälle auf den Straßenverkehr und damit nur ein äußert geringer Teil auf den Eisenbahn- und den Flugverkehr entfallen, wenn die Politik aller Regierungen darin besteht, offen oder de facto das Auto gegenüber allen anderen Verkehrsmitteln zur Personen- oder Güterbeförderung zu bevorteilen.
ilsp.judge: What's the point of lamenting that 95% of accidents occur on road traffic and thus only an extremely small part on rail and air traffic, if the policy of all governments consists in openly or de facto favoring the car over all other modes of transport for the transportation of people or goods.
ilsp.proxy: What good is the regret that 95% of traffic accidents on the roads and thus only a very small part on rail and air transport occur, if the policy of all governments consists in openly or de facto favoring the car over all other modes of transport for passenger or freight transport.
ilsp.reference: What use is lamenting the fact that 95% of traffic accidents occur on roads, and thus only an extremely small part occur in rail and air transport, when all governments' policies consist of openly or de facto favoring cars over all other modes of transportation for passenger or goods transport?

ilsp.query: Zum einen würde kein EU-Staat akzeptieren, wenn ein anderer Mitgliedstaat tolerieren würde, dass ein Flugkapitän in einem Flugzeug mit 300 Passagieren, ein Kapitän zur See, der für die Sicherheit von 1 000 Personen verantwortlich ist, oder ein Lokführer Alkohol trinken würde, bevor er die Verantwortung für seine Passagiere übernimmt.
ilsp.judge: First and foremost, no EU state would accept if another member state would tolerate a flight captain drinking alcohol in a plane with 300 passengers, a ship's captain responsible for the safety of 1,000 people, or a train conductor drinking alcohol before taking responsibility for their passengers.
ilsp.proxy: First, no EU state would accept if another member state were to tolerate a flight captain drinking alcohol in a plane with 300 passengers, a ship captain responsible for the safety of 1,000 people, or a train driver drinking alcohol before taking responsibility for his passengers.
ilsp.reference: For one thing, no EU state would accept it if another member state tolerated a situation where a flight captain on a plane carrying 300 passengers, a ship captain responsible for the safety of 1,000 people, or a locomotive driver drank alcohol before taking responsibility for their passengers.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte betonen, dass ich allgemein voll und ganz mit dem Inhalt des Berichts und seiner Krönung, der Entschließung, einverstanden bin, sowohl im Hinblick auf das laufende Aktionsprogramm, das in Kürze seinen Abschluss findet, als auch in Bezug auf das künftige Programm über die Straßenverkehrssicherheit, dessen Vorlage die Kommission für die nächsten Monate vorgesehen hat.
ilsp.judge: I would like to emphasize that I am in full agreement with the content of the report and its resolution, the decision, in general, both with regard to the ongoing action program, which is due to be completed shortly, and with regard to the future program on road safety, the presentation of which is scheduled for the coming months by the Commission.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to emphasize that I am in full agreement with the content of the report and its conclusion, the resolution, both with regard to the current action programme, which is about to come to an end, and with regard to the future programme on road safety, for which the Commission has planned a proposal for the coming months.
ilsp.reference: I would like to emphasize that I am in full agreement with the content of the report and its conclusion, the resolution, both with regard to the ongoing action program, which will soon come to a close, and concerning the future program on road safety, for which the Commission has prepared a draft for the coming months.

ilsp.query: In einer ersten Etappe müssen die letzten vorrangigen Maßnahmen, die im Rahmen des derzeit laufenden Programms über die Straßenverkehrssicherheit festgelegt wurden, verwirklicht werden. Insbesondere ist vorzuschlagen, dass die Pflicht zum Einbau von Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzern auf eine größere Zahl von Lastkraftwagen angewendet wird, indem Fahrzeuge mit geringerer Nutzlast einbezogen werden.
ilsp.judge: In the first stage, the last priority measures that have been established within the framework of the current program on road traffic safety must be implemented. In particular, it is recommended that the obligation to install speed limiters be applied to a larger number of heavy goods vehicles by including vehicles with lower payload.
ilsp.proxy: In the first stage, the last priority measures that were established within the current program on road safety must be implemented. In particular, it is proposed that the obligation to install speed limiters be applied to a larger number of heavy goods vehicles, by including vehicles with lower load capacity.
ilsp.reference: In the first stage, the final priority measures that have been established for road traffic safety within the current program must be implemented. In particular, it is proposed that the obligation to install speed limiters be extended to a larger number of trucks, including those with lower load capacities.

ilsp.query: Analysiert man die Reibungskosten im intermodalen Güterverkehr im Einzelnen, so ist festzustellen, dass die Hauptproblempunkte gegenüber dem traditionellen unimodalen Verkehr in höheren Preisen, längeren Fahrzeiten, zunehmenden von den Gütern zurückgelegten durchschnittlichen Entfernungen, Qualitätsminderung, größeren Beschädigungsrisiken, Beschränkungen bezüglich der Art der beförderten Güter sowie komplexeren Verwaltungsverfahren liegen.
ilsp.judge: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it can be determined that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, quality degradation, greater damage risks, restrictions on the type of goods being transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
ilsp.proxy: When analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it is found that the main problem points compared to the traditional unimodal transport are higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances traveled by goods, quality reduction, greater risk of damage, restrictions on the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
ilsp.reference: When analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it becomes apparent that the main issues compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer transit times, increased average distances traveled by the goods, quality degradation, greater risk of damage, limitations regarding the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.

ilsp.query: Schließlich kennzeichnet eine Reihe von Hindernissen, verursacht durch mangelnde Harmonisierung der Fristen und Zeitpläne zwischen den einzelnen Verkehrsträgern, das gesamte System, wodurch es zu Unvereinbarkeiten zwischen den mit der Gütertransportkette verknüpften Erfordernissen und den operativen Erfordernissen der im Prozess eingesetzten Ressourcen kommt: So sind beispielsweise die Arbeitszeiten der Fahrer und Besatzungen nicht auf die intermodalen Operationen abgestimmt und die Terminals können sich nicht immer den auf einem 24-Stunden-Dienst beruhenden Zug- und Schiffsplänen anpassen.
ilsp.judge:
# English

In the end, a series of obstacles, caused by a lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between individual modes of transport, characterizes the entire system, resulting in incompatibilities between the requirements linked to the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not adjusted to intermodal operations and terminals cannot always adapt to train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.
ilsp.proxy: Finally, a series of obstacles caused by the lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between individual transport modes characterizes the entire system, leading to inconsistencies between the requirements associated with the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not aligned with intermodal operations and terminals cannot always adapt to the 24-hour schedules of train and ship plans.
ilsp.reference: Finally, a series of obstacles characterize the entire system, caused by the lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between individual transport modes, leading to inconsistencies between the requirements linked to the goods transportation chain and the operational requirements of the resources employed in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not aligned with intermodal operations, and terminals cannot always adapt to the train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.

ilsp.query: In ihrem Bericht "Intermodalität und intermodaler Güterverkehr in der Europäischen Union " hatte die Kommission die im intermodalen Verkehr zu erreichenden Ziele aufgezeigt und sie entsprechend der spezifischen Probleme in drei vorrangige Interventionsbereiche, so genannte Schlüsselaktionen unterteilt. Die erste Schlüsselaktion betrifft die Integration von Infrastruktur und Transportmitteln, die zweite die Interoperabilität und den Verbundbetrieb und die dritte die verkehrsträgerunabhängigen Dienste und Vorschriften.
ilsp.judge: In their report "Intermodality and Intermodal Freight Transport in the European Union", the Commission had shown the goals to be achieved in intermodal transport and divided them into three priority intervention areas, so-called key actions, corresponding to the specific problems. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and transport modes, the second the interoperability and the combined operation, and the third the transport mode-independent services and regulations.
ilsp.proxy: In its report "Intermodality and Intermodal Freight Transport in the European Union", the Commission has shown the targets to be achieved in intermodal transport and has divided them into three priority intervention areas, so-called key actions, according to the specific problems. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and transport means, the second the interoperability and the joint operation and the third the transport mode-independent services and regulations.
ilsp.reference: In her report "Intermodality and Intermodal Goods Traffic in the European Union," the Commission outlined the goals to be achieved in intermodal transport and divided them into three priority intervention areas, known as key actions, according to the specific problems at hand. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and transport modes, the second addresses interoperability and coupled operation, and the third focuses on mode-independent services and regulations.

ilsp.query: Die Kommissionsmitteilung und der Bericht haben viele, ja alle wichtigen Problempunkte zur Sprache gebracht. Die Revisionen der transeuropäischen Netze hin zu einem wirklich intermodalen Netz, Maßnahmen zur Schaffung eines Logistikmehrwertes, Harmonisierungen, die noch nötig sind bei Ladeeinheiten und anderem mehr, wirklich intermodale Informationen, standardisierte Meldungen und Dokumente, Förderung von intermodalen Haftungsregeln und vieles andere mehr.
ilsp.judge: The Commission's statement and the report have brought up many, indeed all, of the key problem points. The revisions of the trans-European networks towards a truly intermodal network, measures to create a logistics added value, harmonizations that are still needed for loading units and other things, truly intermodal information, standardized reports and documents, promotion of intermodal liability rules and many other things.
ilsp.proxy: The Commission communication and the report have brought up many, indeed all, of the key issues. The revision of the trans-European networks to a truly intermodal network, measures to create a logistics added value, harmonizations that are still needed on loading units and other more, truly intermodal information, standardized notifications and documents, promotion of intermodal liability rules and much more.
ilsp.reference: The communication and report have addressed many, indeed all, important issues. Revisions of the trans-European networks towards a truly multimodal network, measures to create added value in logistics, harmonizations still needed for loading units and more, truly multimodal information, standardized reports and documents, promotion of multimodal liability rules, and much more.

ilsp.query: Zur Frage der Intermodalität bei der Überquerung der Alpen ist festzustellen, dass, abgesehen von der Entscheidung der Schweiz zugunsten erheblicher Investitionen im Eisenbahnsektor, ein Besorgnis erregender Rückstand beim Bau der anderen Verkehrsachsen und neuen Eisenbahntunnel besteht, die bereits von der Gemeinschaft geplant wurden, wie die Achse Turin-Lyon-Brenner, oder in der Diskussion sind, wie die Achse Aosta-Martigny.
ilsp.judge: Regarding intermodality in crossing the Alps, it can be established that, aside from Switzerland's decision in favor of significant investments in the rail sector, a cause for concern exists regarding the backlog in the construction of other traffic axes and new railway tunnels that have already been planned by the community, such as the Turin-Lyon-Brenner axis, or are currently under discussion, such as the Aosta-Martigny axis.
ilsp.proxy: Regarding the issue of intermodality in crossing the Alps, it should be noted that, apart from the decision of Switzerland in favor of significant investments in the railway sector, there is a worrying backlog in the construction of other transport axes and new railway tunnels, which were already planned by the Community, such as the Turin-Lyon-Brenner axis, or in the discussion, such as the Aosta-Martigny axis.
ilsp.reference: Regarding the issue of intermodality in crossing the Alps, it must be noted that, apart from Switzerland's decision to invest significantly in the rail sector, there is a concerning backlog in the construction of other transport axes and new railway tunnels that were already planned by the community, such as the Turin-Lyon-Brenner axis, or those currently under discussion, like the Aosta-Martigny axis.

ilsp.query: Der Beitrag, den wir somit leisten, hat zwei Konsequenzen, die ich hier hervorheben möchte: Erstens werden wir, wenn wir dank der Methodik, die wir hoffentlich von der Kommission vorgelegt bekommen und akzeptieren können, eine klarere Definition und Anlastung der internen und externen Kosten an die Nutzer erreichen, die Voraussetzungen dafür schaffen, die Finanzierung der Infrastruktur, die gegenwärtig durch die öffentliche Hand gesichert wird bzw. über die allgemeine Besteuerung erfolgt, auf die Benutzer als solche zu verlagern.
ilsp.judge: The contribution we make in this way has two consequences that I would like to highlight here: Firstly, if we, thanks to the methodology that we hopefully receive and can accept from the commission, achieve a clearer definition and allocation of internal and external costs to the users, we create the conditions to transfer the financing of the infrastructure, which is currently secured by the public hand or takes place through general taxation, to the users as such.
ilsp.proxy: The contribution we are making therefore has two consequences that I would like to highlight: First, if we, thanks to the methodology that we hope to receive and accept from the Commission, achieve a clearer definition and allocation of internal and external costs to users, we will create the conditions for the financing of the infrastructure, which is currently guaranteed by the public sector or through general taxation, to be shifted to users as such.
ilsp.reference: The contribution we thus make has two consequences that I would like to highlight: Firstly, if we, thanks to the methodology that we hope to receive and accept from the Commission, achieve a clearer definition and allocation of both internal and external costs to users, we will create the prerequisites for shifting the financing of the infrastructure, which is currently secured by the public sector or through general taxation, onto users themselves.

ilsp.query: Ich verweise hier auf ein Schreiben der Organisation, welche die Automobilclubs, wie zum Beispiel den AA und den RAC, in ganz Europa repräsentiert, und unsere Arbeit sehr begrüßt und unterstützt. Grund für diese Unterstützung ist die Erkenntnis, dass Europa hier mit gutem Beispiel vorangehen muss und wir die besten Konzepte aus der gesamten Europäischen Union zusammentragen müssen, weil andernfalls die Großstädte, die Städte und ländlichen Gebiete auch weiterhin unter unzumutbaren Verkehrsstaus und einer unerträglichen Umweltverschmutzung zu leiden haben werden.
ilsp.judge: I would like to refer to a letter from the organisation that represents the automobile clubs, such as the AA and the RAC, across all of Europe, and which welcomes and supports our work very much. The reason for this support is the realisation that Europe must set a good example here and we must gather the best concepts from the entire European Union, because otherwise, the large cities, towns, and rural areas will continue to suffer from unbearable traffic congestion and unbearable environmental pollution.

The reason for this support is the realization that Europe must lead the way here and we must gather the best concepts from the entire European Union, because otherwise cities, towns, and rural areas will continue to suffer from intolerable traffic jams and an unbearable environmental pollution.

The reason for this support is the understanding that Europe must set a good example here and we must gather the best concepts from the entire European Union, because otherwise, cities, towns, and rural areas will continue to suffer from unbearable traffic jams and intolerable environmental pollution.

ilsp.query: Wenn mir ein gewisser Vergleich mit der Diskussion erlaubt ist, die vor dem Hintergrund der Probleme im Zusammenhang mit der Nahrungsmittelsicherheit über die Reform der Agrarpolitik gegenwärtig nicht nur in Deutschland, sondern auch in einigen weiteren Mitgliedstaaten - mein Land zählt dazu - geführt wird, so prophezeie ich Ihnen angesichts der heutigen Umweltprobleme - trotz gescheiterter Klimakonferenzen - eine ähnliche Situation auch im Bereich der Verkehrspolitik.
ilsp.judge: If a certain comparison with the discussion is allowed, which is being led in the context of food security issues in the background of the reform of agricultural policy not only in Germany, but also in some other member states - my country is among them - at present, I prophesize to you, in view of the current environmental problems - despite failed climate conferences - a similar situation also in the field of transportation policy.
ilsp.proxy: If a certain comparison with the discussion is allowed, which is currently not only in Germany, but also in several other Member States - my country is included - in connection with the problems of food security, the reform of agricultural policy, I predict a similar situation in the field of transport policy in view of the current environmental problems - despite failed climate conferences.
ilsp.reference: If a comparison with the current discussion on reforming agricultural policy against the background of food security issues, which is not only taking place in Germany but also in several other member states - my country included - is allowed, then I foresee a similar situation in transport policy given today's environmental problems, despite failed climate conferences.

ilsp.query: Dabei erwarten wir nicht, sie würden einhellige Zustimmung finden, vielmehr soll vor allem der Kommission signalisiert werden, wie notwendig es ist, in Bälde eine gewisse Koordinierung, wenn nicht gar Harmonisierung dieser Maßnahmen, zu denen unter anderem die kilometerabhängige Schwerverkehrsabgabe zählt, auf europäischer Ebene vorzunehmen, um zu verhindern, dass sie zwar in dem einen, nicht aber in dem anderen Land angewandt werden, dass das eine Land erklärt, die Kosten seien wissenschaftlich nicht berechenbar, während in dem anderen Land die Berechnung ohne weiteres möglich ist, was selbstverständlich eine völlig groteske Situation wäre.
ilsp.judge: We do not expect them to find unanimous approval, rather we want to signal to the commission above all how necessary it is to implement a certain coordination, if not even harmonization of these measures, including the kilometer-dependent heavy goods vehicle tax, on a European level, in order to prevent them from being applied in one country but not in another, with one country claiming that the costs are scientifically uncalculable, while in the other country the calculation is easily possible, which would, of course, be a completely grotesque situation.
ilsp.proxy: We do not expect unanimous agreement on this, but rather that the Commission is signaled how necessary it is to take some coordination, if not even harmonization of these measures, including the kilometer-dependent heavy traffic charge, in the near future at the European level, in order to prevent them from being applied in one country but not in another, that one country declares that the costs are not scientifically calculable, while in another country the calculation is possible without further ado, which of course would be a completely grotesque situation.
ilsp.reference: We do not expect uniform approval, but rather aim to signal to the Commission how urgent it is to soon coordinate, if not harmonize, these measures, including the kilometer-dependent heavy traffic charge, at the European level, to prevent them from being applied in one country but not in another, where one country declares that the costs cannot be scientifically calculated, while in another country the calculation can be done without any difficulty, which would of course be a completely absurd situation.

ilsp.query: Um es nicht dazu kommen zu lassen, darf unser Ziel nicht darin bestehen, die Verkehrsinfrastrukturkosten zu minimieren, um somit möglichst wenig Kosten anzulasten, sondern wir müssen den Verkehrsbetreibern eine entsprechende Rechtsgrundlage bieten, damit sie die verursachten Kosten der Gruppe anlasten können, die dafür aufzukommen haben, nämlich den Endnutzern.
ilsp.judge: In order to prevent this from happening, our goal must not be to minimize traffic infrastructure costs so as to assign as few costs as possible, but rather we must provide the operators of the traffic with a corresponding legal basis, so that they can assign the costs caused by the group that is responsible for them, namely the end-users.
ilsp.proxy: To prevent this from happening, our goal should not be to minimize transportation infrastructure costs in order to minimize costs as much as possible, but rather we must provide transportation operators with the necessary legal basis so that they can pass on the costs incurred by the group to the end users who are responsible for them.
ilsp.reference: To prevent this from happening, our goal must not be to minimize traffic infrastructure costs in order to shift as little cost as possible, but we must provide traffic operators with the appropriate legal basis so that they can pass on the costs incurred to the group responsible for bearing them, namely the end users.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte die von uns allen mitgetragenen Schwerpunkte noch einmal nennen: Kostenaufteilung in einem direkteren Verhältnis zur Nutzung der Infrastrukturen; Berücksichtigung der sozialen Kosten, aber auch Schutz benachteiligter Gebiete und Bevölkerungsgruppen; Förderung der Umweltverträglichkeit, aber gleichzeitig auch Durchsetzung des Rechts auf Mobilität als Universalrecht.
ilsp.judge: I would like to mention the points that we all have agreed on once again: cost allocation in a more direct proportion to the use of infrastructure; consideration of social costs, but also protection of disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental compatibility, but at the same time also enforcement of the right to mobility as a universal right.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to reiterate the priorities that we have all shared: cost allocation in a more direct relationship to the use of infrastructure; consideration of social costs, but also protection of disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental compatibility, but at the same time also enforcement of the right to mobility as a universal right.
ilsp.reference: I would like to reiterate the focal points that we have all agreed upon: cost allocation in a more direct proportion to the use of infrastructure; consideration of social costs, but also protection for disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental sustainability, but at the same time enforcement of the right to mobility as a universal right.

ilsp.query: Diese Frage der Gebührengestaltung ist also von absolut zentraler Bedeutung. Wenn wir wirklich die gewünschte Verkehrsverlagerung erreichen wollen, müssen wir daher den Mut aufbringen, effektiv eine Internalisierung der externen Kosten herbeizuführen, d. h. dass im Straßenverkehr das bezahlt wird, was er wirklich kostet, dass im Eisenbahnverkehr bezahlt wird, was er kostet und dass die Kostenklarheit zur Preiswahrheit führt.
ilsp.judge: The question of how to structure fees is thus of absolute central importance. If we really want to achieve the desired traffic diversion, we must therefore muster the courage to effectively internalize external costs, i.e., that in road traffic, what it really costs is paid for, that in rail traffic, what it costs is paid for, and that cost transparency leads to price truth.
ilsp.proxy: This question of fee setting is therefore of absolute central importance. If we really want to achieve the desired shift in traffic, we must therefore have the courage to effectively internalize external costs, i.e. that in road traffic what it really costs is paid, that in rail traffic what it costs is paid and that cost clarity leads to price truth.
