lsp.query: Herr Präsident, die durch mich in diesem Europäischen Parlament repräsentierte Rentnerpartei vertritt die Auffassung und erhebt die Forderung, dass die Kommission, das Europäische Parlament und der Rat die Fischereipolitik in wesentlichen Teilen ändern müssen: Dies betrifft die inzwischen fest verwurzelte Angewohnheit, in fremden Gewässern zu fischen und dann sein Gewissen zu beruhigen, indem an die Regierungen der Länder, deren Hoheitsgewässer wir befischt haben, ein bestimmter Geldbetrag gezahlt wird.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, the pensioners' party represented by me in this European Parliament holds the view and makes the demand that the Commission, the European Parliament, and the Council must change the fisheries policy in substantial parts: This concerns the now deeply ingrained habit of fishing in foreign waters and then calming one's conscience by paying a certain amount of money to the governments of the countries whose territorial waters we have fished.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, the Pensioners' Party, which I represent in this European Parliament, holds the view and makes the demand that the Commission, the European Parliament, and the Council must fundamentally change the fisheries policy: This concerns the now firmly established habit of fishing in foreign waters and then appeasing one's conscience by paying a certain amount of money to the governments of the countries whose territorial waters we have fished.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, the pensioner party represented in this European Parliament believes that the Commission, the European Parliament, and the Council must change fisheries policy in essential parts: This concerns the now firmly established habit of fishing in foreign waters and then calming one's conscience by paying a certain amount of money to the governments of the countries whose territorial waters we have fished in.

lsp.query: Da die Gemeinschaft gemäß der einschlägigen Erklärung in Artikel 5 Absatz 1 des Anhangs IX des Internationalen Seerechtsübereinkommens allein für die Erhaltung und Bewirtschaftung der Fischbestände zuständig und damit befugt ist, die entsprechenden Regeln und Bestimmungen festzulegen, sollte die Kommission von dieser Befugnis Gebrauch machen und das ausschließliche Fangrecht auch für die griechischen Fischer auf 12 Seemeilen festlegen.
lsp.judge: In accordance with the relevant declaration in Article 5, paragraph 1 of Annex IX to the International Convention on the Law of the Sea, the community is responsible and authorized for the conservation and management of fish stocks, and thus entitled to establish the corresponding rules and regulations. The Commission should exercise this authority and also set the exclusive fishing right to 12 nautical miles for Greek fishermen.
lsp.proxy: Since the Community, in accordance with the relevant declaration in Article 5(1) of Annex IX of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, is solely responsible for the conservation and management of fish stocks and is therefore authorized to establish the relevant rules and regulations, the Commission should use this authority to set the exclusive fishing rights for Greek fishermen at 12 nautical miles as well.
lsp.reference: Since the Community, according to the relevant statement in Article 5(1) of Annex IX to the International Convention for the Regulation of Whaling, is alone responsible for the conservation and management of fish stocks and thus entitled to determine the corresponding rules and regulations, the Commission should make use of this entitlement and establish the exclusive fishing right also for Greek fishermen at 12 nautical miles.

lsp.query: Der gemeinsame Entschließungsantrag zum "Balkan-Syndrom " dient lediglich dazu, die kriminelle Politik der NATO und der Europäischen Union zu bemänteln, die unter dem Vorwand, die Menschenrechte verteidigen zu wollen, in Jugoslawien interveniert haben und dadurch irreparable menschliche und materielle Schäden verursacht haben.
lsp.judge: The joint resolution motion on the "Balkan Syndrome" serves merely to whitewash the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of wanting to defend human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.
lsp.proxy: The joint motion for resolution on the "Balkan Syndrome" serves merely to cover up the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which, under the pretext of defending human rights, intervened in Yugoslavia and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.
lsp.reference: The common resolution proposal on the "Balkan Syndrome" merely serves to cloak the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of wanting to defend human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.

lsp.query: Abgesehen davon spricht der Entschließungsantrag kurz überaus ernste Fragen im Zusammenhang mit der Analyse und der notwendigen Erforschung von abgereichertem Uran an, geht aber an keiner Stelle auf die fortgesetzten Bemühungen ein, Tatsachen, unabhängige, uns allen bekannte Forschungsarbeiten, ja sogar wissenschaftliche Abhandlungen aus NATO-Ländern zu verschleiern und zu verheimlichen, die die Gefährlichkeit von abgereichertem Uran nachweisen und Vorsorgemaßnahmen nennen, die diese Länder ihren Streitkräften auferlegen.
lsp.judge: Apart from that, the resolution proposal briefly addresses extremely serious questions related to the analysis and necessary research of depleted uranium, but it does not address the continued efforts to conceal and cover up facts, independent and well-known research works, yes, even scientific papers from NATO countries, which demonstrate the danger of depleted uranium and recommend preventive measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.
lsp.proxy: Apart from that, the motion for a resolution briefly raises extremely serious questions concerning the analysis and necessary research of depleted uranium, but at no point does it address the ongoing efforts to obscure and conceal facts, independent, well-known research, and even scientific papers from NATO countries that demonstrate the dangers of depleted uranium and outline precautionary measures imposed on their armed forces.
lsp.reference: Apart from that, the resolution motion briefly touches on extremely serious issues related to the analysis and necessary research of enriched uranium, but nowhere addresses the ongoing efforts to conceal and hide facts, independent research works known to all of us, and even scientific papers from NATO countries that demonstrate the danger of enriched uranium and preventive measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.

lsp.query: Wir sehen mit großer Sorge, dass es, auch durch das Handeln des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats - und Herr Solana, den ich hoch schätze, kümmert sich ja mehr um die Aufgabe des Hohen Vertreters - an der Spitze des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats manche Abschottungen gibt, dass man weder der Kommission noch dem Europäischen Parlament Informationen geben will.
lsp.judge: We see with great concern that, even through the actions of the Council Secretariat - and Mr. Solana, whom I highly esteem, is indeed more concerned with the task of the High Representative - there are some exclusions at the top of the Council Secretariat, that one does not want to give information to either the Commission or the European Parliament.
lsp.proxy: We observe with great concern that there are some barriers at the top of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers, also due to the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers - and Mr. Solana, whom I hold in high regard, is more concerned with the task of the High Representative - in that they are unwilling to provide information either to the Commission or to the European Parliament.
lsp.reference: We see with great concern that, despite the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council - and I highly esteem Mr. Solana, who indeed takes more interest in the task of the High Representative - there are some isolations at the top of the General Secretariat of the Council, where neither the Commission nor the European Parliament is willing to share information.

lsp.query: Erstens, wird der schwedische Ratsvorsitz einen Rat oder eine Sondersitzung einberufen, zu der die Regierungsvertreter der Beitrittsländer eingeladen werden, um einerseits die Verhandlungen voranzubringen und andererseits das wichtige Signal für die Öffentlichkeit zu setzen, dass die Erweiterung nicht nur ein politisches Ziel, eine Fata Morgana, ein noch immer fernes Ziel ist, sondern dass wir auch tatsächlich die notwendigen Fortschritte erreichen?
lsp.judge: Firstly, the Swedish presidency will convene a council or an extraordinary session to which the government representatives of the accession countries will be invited, in order to, on the one hand, advance the negotiations and, on the other hand, send an important signal to the public that the expansion is not just a political goal, a mirage, a still distant goal, but that we are actually making the necessary progress.
lsp.proxy: First, the Swedish presidency will convene a Council or special session to which representatives of the governments of the candidate countries will be invited, both to advance the negotiations and to send an important signal to the public that enlargement is not just a political goal, a mirage, a still distant objective, but that we are also making the necessary progress.
lsp.reference: Firstly, the Swedish presidency will convene a council or extraordinary session at which representatives of the candidate countries will be invited, in order to advance the negotiations on the one hand and, on the other hand, to send an important signal to the public that enlargement is not just a political goal, a mirage, still a distant objective, but that we are actually making the necessary progress?

lsp.query: Der von mir bereits erwähnte Beschluss besagt, dass ein Bürger eines EU-Mitgliedstaates, der sich um konsularische Hilfe an eine diplomatische oder konsularische Vertretung eines anderen Mitgliedstaates wendet, so zu behandeln ist, als wäre er Bürger des Landes, das durch die betreffende Botschaft oder das Konsulat vertreten wird.
lsp.judge: The decision I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state is to be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the relevant embassy or consulate.
lsp.proxy: The decision I have already mentioned states that a citizen of an EU Member State who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular mission of another Member State shall be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate in question.
lsp.reference: The resolution I have already mentioned states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state should be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate.

lsp.query: Ich möchte den Ratsvorsitzenden Folgendes fragen: Wird die schwedische Präsidentschaft nach dieser Tragödie, die wir erlebt haben und die offiziell mindestens 60 Menschen das Leben gekostet hat, sowie angesichts der Folterungen, des Schicksals von Menschen, die vielleicht nur deshalb im Gefängnis sitzen, weil sie ihre Muttersprache gesprochen haben, und des Hungerstreiks, in dem sich noch immer etwa 200 Häftlinge befinden, öffentlich irgendeine Initiative ergreifen, wird sie Erklärungen und Zusagen von der türkischen Regierung verlangen? Und wird sich die schwedische Präsidentschaft endlich für die Freilassung der Abgeordneten Leyla Zana einsetzen, der von diesem Parlament der Sacharow-Preis verliehen worden ist?
lsp.judge: I would like to ask the chairperson the following: Will the Swedish presidency, in light of this tragedy that we have experienced and which has officially cost the lives of at least 60 people, as well as in light of the torture, the fate of people who may only be in prison because they spoke their mother tongue, and the hunger strike in which approximately 200 inmates are still participating, take any public initiative? Will it demand explanations and promises from the Turkish government? And will the Swedish presidency finally advocate for the release of MP Leyla Zana, who was awarded the Sakharov Prize by this parliament?
lsp.proxy: I would like to ask the Council President the following: Will the Swedish Presidency, in the wake of this tragedy that we have experienced and which has officially cost at least 60 people their lives, as well as in light of the torture, the fate of people who may be in prison simply for speaking their mother tongue, and the hunger strike in which about 200 prisoners are still participating, take any public initiative, will it demand statements and commitments from the Turkish government? And will the Swedish Presidency finally work for the release of Member of Parliament Leyla Zana, who was awarded the Sakharov Prize by this Parliament?
lsp.reference: I would like to ask the Council President: Will the Swedish presidency take any public initiative after this tragedy, which has officially cost at least 60 lives, as well as considering the torture, the fate of people who might be in prison merely because they spoke their mother tongue, and the hunger strike in which around 200 prisoners are still participating? And will the Swedish presidency finally advocate for the release of Deputy Leyla Zana, who was awarded the Sakharov Prize by this parliament?

lsp.query: Die Union hat u. a. auf der letzten Ministerratstagung der ASEAN-Staaten in Vientiane im Dezember 2000 ihre Erwartung deutlich gemacht, dass die EU-Troika die gleichen Möglichkeiten der Kontaktaufnahme zu allen beteiligten Parteien erhält, seien es nun Vertreter der Regierung, der National League for Democracy oder ethnischer Minderheiten.
lsp.judge: The Union has, inter alia, made it clear at the last ASEAN ministerial meeting in Vientiane in December 2000 that the EU Troika should have the same opportunities for contact with all parties involved, whether they be representatives of the government, the National League for Democracy, or ethnic minorities.

lsp.query: Der Rat begrüßt außerdem die Tatsache, dass sich die EU und die ASEAN in ihrer in Vientiane beschlossenen gemeinsamen Erklärung verpflichten, die Bemühungen des Sonderbeauftragten des UNO-Generalsekretärs für Birma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, um eine positive Entwicklung in Burma zu unterstützen.
lsp.judge: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint statement adopted in Vientiane to supporting the efforts of the UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy for Myanmar, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Myanmar.

lsp.query: Abschließend noch eine letzte kritische Anmerkung: 1994 hat Aung San Suu Kyi Gespräche mit dem SLORC, wie der SPDC sich damals nannte, geführt und dabei wurde ihr vorgeworfen, sie sei viel zu unflexibel und man könne nicht mit ihr zusammenarbeiten, weil sie nicht von ihrer Forderung nach der Anerkennung der Wahlen von 1990 durch den SLORC abweiche.
lsp.judge: In conclusion, one final critical remark: In 1994, Aung San Suu Kyi held talks with the SLORC, which was then known as the SPDC, and she was accused of being too inflexible and that it was impossible to work with her because she refused to deviate from her demand for the SLORC to recognize the 1990 elections.

lsp.query: Im Ausschuss für Regionalpolitik, Verkehr und Fremdenverkehr ist man sich jedoch darüber im Klaren, dass die Gewerkschaften und die Luftfahrtunternehmen am besten geeignet sind, um eine Lösung für dieses Problem zu finden, und so haben sich die Mitglieder des Ausschusses in einem Kompromiss darauf geeinigt, allen Beteiligten bis zum 1. Mai 2001 Zeit zu geben, um eine Einigung zu erreichen, auf deren Grundlage dann der Text des neuen Abschnitts Q erstellt werden soll.
lsp.judge: In the Committee on Regional Policy, Transport and Tourism, however, it is clear that the trade unions and the airlines are best suited to find a solution to this problem, and so the committee members have agreed on a compromise to give all parties until May 1, 2001, to reach an agreement, on the basis of which the text of the new section Q will then be created.

lsp.query: Zwar liegen noch keine vollständigen und 100-prozentig gesicherten Erkenntnisse darüber vor, aber wir erkennen zumindest den Ernst der Situation und fragen uns, ob wir die Kommission in diesem Fall nicht durch einen Änderungsantrag - ansonsten würden wir einen anderen Weg wählen - ersuchen, bestimmte Maßnahmen auf diesem Gebiet zu ergreifen.
lsp.judge: While there are as yet no complete and 100-percent secure findings on the matter, we at least acknowledge the gravity of the situation and wonder whether we should not request the commission, by way of a motion to amend - otherwise we would choose a different path - to take certain measures in this regard.
lsp.proxy: Although we do not yet have complete and 100 percent secure findings on this matter, we at least recognize the seriousness of the situation and are wondering whether we should not ask the Commission, through an amendment - otherwise we would choose a different path - to take certain measures in this area.
lsp.reference: Although we do not yet have complete and 100 percent certain insights into this matter, we at least recognize the severity of the situation and wonder whether we should ask the Commission in this case to take certain measures on this issue through a proposal for a motion - otherwise, we would choose another path.

lsp.query: Lassen Sie mich, Frau Kommissarin, noch kurz Folgendes bemerken: Meines Erachtens ist es gegenüber unserem Parlament äußerst unhöflich, dass im Vorgriff auf unsere heute Abend geführte Aussprache, in der doch eine Verordnung über den höchstzulässigen Blutalkoholspiegel befürwortet wird, das Kommissionsmitglied nunmehr offensichtlich bereits entschieden hat, eine Empfehlung an die Mitgliedstaaten reiche aus.
lsp.judge: Please allow me, Commissioner, to make a brief remark: In my opinion, it is extremely impolite towards our parliament that, in anticipation of our discussion this evening, in which a regulation on the maximum permissible blood alcohol level is actually being proposed, the Commission member has now clearly decided that a recommendation to the member states would be sufficient.
lsp.proxy: Let me, Commissioner, add one more thing: In my opinion, it is extremely impolite towards our Parliament that, in anticipation of today's debate, in which a regulation on the maximum permissible blood alcohol level is being advocated, the Commission member has now apparently already decided that a recommendation to the Member States would be sufficient.
lsp.reference: Let me, Commissioner, make one more remark: In my opinion, it is extremely impolite towards our Parliament that, in light of today's debate in which we are supporting a regulation on the maximum blood alcohol level, the Commission member has now clearly decided that a recommendation to the Member States is sufficient.

lsp.query: Meines Erachtens wird hierdurch deutlich, dass die Verkehrssicherheit nicht mit herausgegriffenen Einzelmaßnahmen im erforderlichen Maße erhöht werden kann, sondern dass dies nur durch einen ganzen Komplex von Maßnahmen machbar ist, und dazu gehören Verkehrserziehung, Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung, Alkoholbegrenzung, besserer Straßenausbau, Verkehrsleitsysteme, erhöhter Sicherheitsstandard der Fahrzeuge, stärkere Kontrollen der Einhaltung der Straßenverkehrsordnung und auch eine permanente Begutachtung der Fahrzeuge, die sich im Straßenverkehr befinden.
lsp.judge: In my opinion, it becomes clear that road safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive set of measures, including traffic education, speed limits, alcohol restrictions, improved road infrastructure, traffic management systems, enhanced vehicle safety standards, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles that are in operation on the roads.
lsp.proxy: In my opinion, this clearly shows that traffic safety cannot be significantly increased by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive set of measures, which include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol restrictions, better road construction, traffic guidance systems, higher safety standards for vehicles, stronger enforcement of traffic regulations, and also continuous inspection of vehicles on the road.
lsp.reference: In my opinion, it becomes clear here that traffic safety cannot be increased sufficiently through makeshift individual measures alone, but can only be achieved through a comprehensive range of measures, which include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, better road infrastructure, traffic control systems, higher vehicle safety standards, stronger enforcement of traffic regulations, and also continuous inspection of vehicles in circulation.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Straßenverkehrssicherheit kann und muss sowohl für Europa insgesamt als auch für jedes einzelne Land eine Priorität darstellen. Deshalb stimme ich auch dem Vorschlag von Frau Hedkvist Petersen - die ich mir an dieser Stelle zu ihrem Bericht zu beglückwünschen erlaube - zu, einen strategischen Plan für die Straßenverkehrssicherheit zu entwerfen und eine Reihe strikter, aber auch realistischer quantitativer Ziele festzulegen.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, road safety can and must be a priority both for Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That's why I also agree with the proposal by Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen - whom I would like to congratulate on her report at this point - to draw up a strategic plan for road safety and set a series of strict, but also realistic, quantitative targets.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, road safety can and must be a priority for Europe as a whole as well as for each individual country. Therefore, I also agree with the proposal by Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen - whom I would like to congratulate on her report at this point - to design a strategic plan for road safety and to set a series of strict but also realistic quantitative targets.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, road traffic safety must and can be a priority for Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That is why I also support Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen's proposal – which I would like to congratulate her on at this point regarding her report – to develop a strategic plan for road traffic safety and to set a series of strict but also realistic quantitative goals.

lsp.query: Außerdem können auch andere, in dem Bericht erwähnte Vorschläge, wie die stärkere Unterstützung des europäischen Programms zur Bewertung von Neufahrzeugen, die Förderung von Kampagnen zugunsten der Verwendung von Sicherheitsgurten, die Entwicklung von Telematiksystemen sowie der obligatorische Einbau von Tagesfahrlichtern in Motorrädern und Fahrzeugen, relativ kostengünstig mit hohem Nutzen für die Straßenverkehrssicherheit und die Volksgesundheit verwirklicht werden.
lsp.judge: In addition, other proposals mentioned in the report, such as stronger support for the European program for evaluating new vehicles, promoting campaigns for the use of seatbelts, the development of telematics systems, as well as the mandatory installation of daytime running lights in motorcycles and vehicles, can be implemented relatively inexpensively with high benefits for road safety and public health.

lsp.judge: What I mean to say is that we by no means rejected working on regulations regarding front-end constructions that are less hazardous for humans and unprotected bodies, but rather we simply want to be more effective by gaining the support of the automotive sector.

lsp.query: Deshalb sollte sich das Präsidium mit dieser wichtigen Angelegenheit befassen, und ich möchte anfragen, ob es darüber informiert ist und ob es bei den Straßburger Behörden wegen zusätzlicher Maßnahmen zum Schutz des Parlaments vorstellig geworden ist. Wenn ich es richtig sehe, hat fast jedermann Zutritt zum Parlament, und ich befürchte, wir haben uns auf überaus gefährliche und unvorhersehbare Ereignisse einzustellen.
lsp.judge: Therefore, the presidency should deal with this important matter, and I would like to ask if it has been informed about it and if it has approached the Strasbourg authorities regarding additional measures to protect the parliament. lsp.query: In unserer Stellungnahme wollten wir die gesamte Herstellungskette der Forstwirtschaft einschließlich der Waldpflege und Holzgewinnung sowie der Bedeutung von Rentabilität der Forstwirtschaft als Rohstoffgrundlage herausstellen, gründet sich doch eine nachhaltige europäische Forstwirtschaft nach wie vor auf die sogenannte "Familienwirtschaft " von zwölf Millionen privaten Waldbesitzern und ihrer Tätigkeit.
lsp.judge: In our statement, we wanted to highlight the entire production chain of forestry, including forest management and wood harvesting, as well as the importance of forestry profitability as a raw material basis, since a sustainable European forestry system still relies on the so-called "family forestry" of twelve million private forest owners and their activities.
lsp.proxy: In our statement, we wanted to highlight the entire production chain of forestry, including forest maintenance and timber harvesting, as well as the importance of the profitability of forestry as a raw material base, since sustainable European forestry continues to be based on the so-called "family economy" of twelve million private forest owners and their activities.

lsp.query: Vor allem für die Angehörigen der Opfer ist es nämlich unerträglich, dass noch keiner der Kommandeure der Roten Khmer für die von ihnen verübten Verbrechen bestraft worden ist und die Hauptschuldigen am Genozid völlig unbehelligt in Kambodscha leben, ganz zu schweigen von der Beteiligung ehemaliger Roter Khmer an der Regierung.
lsp.judge: Above all, it is unbearable for the relatives of the victims that none of the commanders of the Khmer Rouge have been punished for the crimes they committed, and that the main perpetrators of the genocide are completely unharmed and living in Cambodia, not to mention the involvement of former Khmer Rouge members in the government.
lsp.proxy: Above all, it is intolerable for the relatives of the victims that none of the commanders of the Khmer Rouge have been punished for the crimes they committed, and that the main perpetrators of the genocide live completely unscathed in Cambodia, not to mention the involvement of former Khmer Rouge in the government.
lsp.reference: Es ist besonders für die relatives der Opfer unerträglich, dass bis heute keiner der Kommandeure der Roten Khmer für die von ihnen begangenen Verbrechen verantwortlich gemacht wurde und die Hauptverantwortlichen am Genozid in Kambodscha ungestraft leben, geschweige denn, dass ehemalige Roter Khmer an der Regierung beteiligt waren.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Älteren unter uns haben die außergewöhnlichen, grauenhaften Berichte, die 1975 aus Kambodscha kamen, noch nicht vergessen. Es gab Luftaufnahmen von einer verlassenen Hauptstadt, weil die Roten Khmer, deren Anführer nach den Lehrsätzen der Gewalt in der Tradition der französischen Revolution geschult wurden und von einer Mischung aus politischem Idealismus und Massenpsychopathologie erfüllt waren, zwei Millionen Menschen von der Stadt auf das Land umsiedelten, um unter der Führung des "großen " Pol Pot im Jahre Null mit einer neuen Gesellschaft zu beginnen.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, those of us who are older have not forgotten the extraordinary, horrific reports that came from Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city, because the Red Khmer, whose leaders were trained in the teachings of violence in the tradition of the French Revolution and were filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathology, forcibly relocated two million people from the city to the countryside to begin a new society under the leadership of the "great" Pol Pot in Year Zero.

lsp.query: Davon abgesehen war die erste Reaktion der VN nach Erhalt einer inoffiziellen Übersetzung verhalten positiv und die Kommission hofft nun, dass die noch offenen Fragen gelöst werden können, damit der neue Gerichtshof mit Hilfe der UNO verbessert und das Abkommen zwischen der kambodschanischen Regierung und den Vereinten Nationen schnell umgesetzt werden können.
lsp.judge: Aside from this, the first reaction of the UN after receiving an unofficial translation was cautiously positive, and the commission now hopes that the remaining open questions can be resolved so that the new court can be improved with the help of the UN and the agreement between the Cambodian government and the United Nations can be quickly implemented.

lsp.query: Georgien wird heute buchstäblich durch seinen großen Nachbarn erstickt; das Land wird mit Öl­, Gas- und Stromlieferungen sowie mit Visavorschriften erpresst und ist dieser unglaublichen Diskriminierung zwischen den Bürgern Südossetiens und Abchasiens einerseits und den übrigen georgischen Bürgern andererseits ausgesetzt.
lsp.judge: Georgia is literally being strangled today by its large neighbour; the country is being blackmailed with oil, gas, and electricity supplies as well as visa restrictions, and is exposed to this unbelievable discrimination between the citizens of South Ossetia and Abkhazia on the one hand and the rest of Georgian citizens on the other.
lsp.proxy: Georgia is today literally being suffocated by its large neighbor; the country is being extorted through oil, gas, and electricity supplies as well as visa regulations, and is subjected to this incredible discrimination between the citizens of South Ossetia and Abkhazia on the one hand and the rest of the Georgian citizens on the other.

lsp.query: Wir warten vergebens auf den einzigen geeigneten Vorschlag, um die gesamte Region zu stabilisieren, um vor die Tore Tschetscheniens zu gelangen, um der russischen Umklammerung dieser Region ein Ende zu setzen, den einzigen seriösen Vorschlag, der darin bestünde, dass Georgien offiziell vorgeschlagen wird, der Europäischen Union beizutreten.
lsp.judge: We are waiting in vain for a single suitable proposal to stabilize the entire region, to reach the gates of Chechnya, to put an end to Russia's encirclement of this region, the only serious proposal that would consist of Georgia being officially proposed to join the European Union.

lsp.query: Der einseitig eingeführte Visumzwang für Georgien, mit Ausklammerung von zwei Gebieten, die Georgien unterstellt sind, bringt neue Spaltpilze in ein Land, das dem Europarat angehört, das sich demokratisch entwickeln will und mit dem wir ein Abkommen geschlossen haben, um sie eben in all ihren Bereichen zu unterstützen.
lsp.judge: The one-sided introduction of a visa requirement for Georgia, excluding two regions that are under Georgia's jurisdiction, brings new divisions to a country that belongs to the Council of Europe, which wants to develop democratically and with whom we have signed an agreement to support them in all areas.
lsp.proxy: The unilateral introduction of visa requirements for Georgia, with the exception of two regions that are subordinate to Georgia, brings new dividing forces into a country that belongs to the Council of Europe, which wants to develop democratically and with which we have concluded an agreement to support it in all areas.
lsp.reference: The one-sided introduction of a visa requirement for Georgia, with two areas exempted that Georgia considers its own, introduces new divisionary fungi into a country that belongs to the Council of Europe, which wishes to develop democratically and with which we have concluded an agreement to support it in all areas.

lsp.query: Unsere Bitte an die Kommission ist deshalb, zusammen mit dem Rat zu überlegen, ob wir diese Konfliktfälle nicht besser aufarbeiten und darangehen sollten, mit Entscheidungen, die in die richtige Richtung gehen, den Menschen dort, die eine demokratische Gesellschaft aufbauen wollen und friedliche Zukunftsvisionen brauchen, zu helfen und Georgien zu unterstützen, damit es die Menschenrechte einhalten und den übrigen im Europarat eingegangenen Verpflichtungen nachkommen kann.
lsp.judge: Our request to the Commission is therefore to consider together with the Council whether we should not better process these conflict cases and proceed with decisions that are heading in the right direction, to help the people there who want to build a democratic society and need peaceful visions of the future, and to support Georgia so that it can uphold human rights and fulfill the other obligations it has entered into within the Council of Europe.
lsp.proxy: Our request to the Commission is therefore to consider together with the Council whether we should not better address these conflict cases and work towards helping the people there who want to build a democratic society and need peaceful future visions, by making decisions that move in the right direction, and supporting Georgia so that it can uphold human rights and comply with the other obligations it has undertaken within the Council of Europe.

ilsp.query: Im vorliegenden Fall geht es um die Politik eines großen Nahrungsmittelkonzerns, der Umsätze erzielt hat, die selbst der Konzernchef als hervorragend bezeichnet, und zur gleichen Zeit den Beschluss fasst, 3 000 Stellen zu streichen und mehrere Werke in einigen Mitgliedstaaten der Europäischen Union zu schließen.
ilsp.judge: In the present case, it is about the policy of a large food conglomerate that has achieved sales that even the company's CEO describes as excellent, and at the same time decides to cut 3,000 jobs and close several plants in some member states of the European Union.

ilsp.query: Wir halten es für unsere Aufgabe, dem algerischen Volk eine Botschaft des Mitgefühls und der Solidarität zu übermitteln und die algerische Regierung zu ermutigen, mit Hilfe der Europäischen Union politisch gegen diese Probleme vorzugehen, was den Erwartungen der überwältigenden Mehrheit der algerischen Bevölkerung entsprechen würde, die sich genauso wenig wie wir mit dieser blinden, ihr Land heimsuchenden Gewalt abfinden kann.
ilsp.judge: We consider it our task to convey a message of empathy and solidarity to the Algerian people and to encourage the Algerian government to take a political stance against these problems with the help of the European Union, which would correspond to the expectations of the overwhelming majority of the Algerian population, who, just like us, cannot come to terms with this blind, devastating violence that is afflicting their country.

ilsp.query: In der berühmt-berüchtigten Sonderzulage, die so viel Kritik ausgelöst hat, möchte ich anmerken, dass, wenn jeder Bedienstete der Europäischen Zentralbank pro Jahr Anrecht auf eine 9 %ige Gehaltszulage hat, die 38 %, die ihnen über einen Zeitraum von 54 Monaten gezahlt wurden, einem Satz von 8,5 % pro Jahr entsprechen.
ilsp.judge: In the infamous special allowance that has sparked so much criticism, I would like to note that, if every employee of the European Central Bank has a right to a 9% salary allowance per year, the 38% that were paid to them over a period of 54 months correspond to a rate of 8.5% per year.

ilsp.query: Der springende Punkt ist unseres Erachtens vielmehr das Folgende: Je mehr wir die Autorität der betreffenden Währungsorgane anerkennen - und ich schließe mich dieser Anerkennung an, jedoch nicht, ohne voller Überzeugung die Notwendigkeit einer politischen Verwaltung der Wirtschaft, auch auf europäischer Ebene, hervorzuheben -, desto mehr müssen wir leuchtende Beispiele für Effizienz, Lohnmäßigung und Transparenz verlangen.
ilsp.judge: The key point, in our view, is rather the following: The more we acknowledge the authority of the relevant currency authorities - and I join in this acknowledgment, but not without emphasizing, with full conviction, the need for a political administration of the economy, even at the European level - the more we must demand shining examples of efficiency, wage moderation, and transparency.
ilsp.proxy: The crux of the matter, in our view, is rather the following: The more we recognize the authority of the relevant monetary authorities—and I join in this recognition, without, however, failing to emphasize with full conviction the necessity of political management of the economy, also at the European level—the more we must demand shining examples of efficiency, wage moderation, and transparency.
ilsp.reference: The crucial point, in our view, is this: The more we recognize the authority of the respective monetary bodies – and I concur with this recognition, though not without emphasizing the necessity for political administration of the economy, also at the European level – the more we must demand shining examples of efficiency, wage moderation, and transparency.

ilsp.query: Wir müssen begreifen, dass die Zeiten, in denen ein Arbeitsplatz ein ganzes Leben lang hielt, heute vorbei sind; dass neue Arbeitsmöglichkeiten erdacht werden müssen und dass der KMU- und der Handwerkssektor unseren Jugendlichen und den Unionsbürgern in Zukunft immer mehr reale Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten bieten werden.
ilsp.judge: We must understand that the times when a job would last a whole lifetime are over; that new job opportunities need to be created and that the SME and crafts sector will offer our young people and Union citizens more and more real job opportunities in the future.

ilsp.query: Leider wurden das italienisch-schweizerische Übereinkommen und die entsprechende Verordnung von der italienischen Regierung falsch ausgelegt: Sie hat nämlich bisher an Arbeitnehmer, die in Italien und in der Schweiz beschäftigt waren, nur eine Rente in Höhe der halbierten Hälfte, d. h. also ein Viertel dessen bezahlt, was ihnen laut Urteil italienischer Richter der ersten und der zweiten Instanz zusteht.
ilsp.judge: Unfortunately, the Italian-Swiss agreement and the corresponding regulation were misinterpreted by the Italian government: it has indeed only paid a pension worth half of half, i.e. a quarter of what, according to the judgment of Italian judges of the first and second instance, is due to workers who were employed in Italy and Switzerland.
ilsp.proxy: Unfortunately, the Italian-Swiss agreement and the corresponding regulation have been misinterpreted by the Italian government: it has so far paid only a pension amounting to half of the half, i.e., one quarter of what is due to workers who were employed in both Italy and Switzerland, according to the judgment of Italian first and second instance judges.
ilsp.reference: Unfortunately, the Italian-Swiss agreement and the corresponding regulation have been misinterpreted by the Italian government: up until now, it has only paid pensions to workers who were employed in Italy and Switzerland at half the amount, that is, one quarter of what Italian judges of the first and second instance have ruled they are entitled to.

ilsp.judge: The Commission is aware that the UK regulatory body has expressed its satisfaction since the publication of the review report in November, for example, as British Nuclear Fuels Limited has handled the fifteen specific recommendations of the report for the demonstration facility, and that these recommendations, as it is called in nuclear terminology, have been completed, that is, considered fulfilled.

ilsp.query: Abschließend und im Rahmen dieser Hilfen für die erneuerbaren Energien, die für mich wesentlich sind und nicht nur für Erklärungen herhalten, sondern eine Zielsetzung darstellen - und denken Sie daran, dass zum ersten Mal Staat für Staat konkrete und differenzierte Ziele aufgestellt werden und zwar in der Richtlinie über grüne Energie -, halte ich es auf jeden Fall für unerlässlich, der Forschung im Nuklearsektor weiterhin Unterstützung zu geben, insbesondere im Bereich der Sicherheit, Lagerung und Aufbereitung von Rückständen, denn sie u vergraben ist keine Lösung, oder bei Alternativfragen wie beispielsweise der Kernfusion.
ilsp.judge: In conclusion, and within the framework of these aids for renewable energies, which are essential to me and not just there to provide explanations, but represent a goal-setting - and remember that for the first time, state by state, concrete and differentiated goals are being set, namely in the directive on green energy - I firmly believe it is essential to continue supporting research in the nuclear sector, particularly in the areas of safety, storage, and processing of residues, because burying it is no solution, or in alternative questions such as, for example, nuclear fusion.
ilsp.proxy: In conclusion, and within the framework of these aids for renewable energies, which are essential for me and not just for explanations but as a goal - and remember that for the first time, country-by-country specific and differentiated targets are being set out in the green energy directive - I consider it absolutely essential to continue supporting research in the nuclear sector, particularly in the areas of safety, storage, and processing of waste, because burying it is not a solution, or in alternative issues such as nuclear fusion.
ilsp.reference: Finally, and within the framework of these aids for renewable energies, which are crucial for me and not just for explanations but represent a goal – and remember that for the first time concrete and differentiated targets have been set on a country-to-country basis, specifically in the Green Energy Directive – I consider it absolutely essential to continue supporting research in the nuclear sector, especially in the areas of safety, storage, and processing of waste, because burying it is not a solution, or when considering alternative questions such as nuclear fusion, for example.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, da wir dieses Thema gestern in unserem Fischereiausschuss behandelt haben, möchte ich Sie im Namen des Ausschusses sowie und vor allem im Namen der Berichterstatter, die wir heute über das Thema debattieren werden, darum bitten, sofern der Herr Kommissar, mit dem ich gesprochen habe, keine Einwände hat - und die hat er im Prinzip nicht -, dass wir zunächst die Erklärung des Kommissars selbst hören und wir, die übrigen Berichterstatter, entsprechend der festgelegten Reihenfolge im Anschluss daran zu Wort kommen können.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, since we have already discussed this topic in our Fisheries Committee yesterday, I would like to ask you, on behalf of the committee and above all on behalf of the rapporteurs who we will be debating on this topic today, to please, if the Commissioner with whom I have spoken has no objections - and he doesn't, in principle - that we first hear the Commissioner's explanation and that the rest of the rapporteurs can then speak in the established order afterwards.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, since we discussed this topic in our Fisheries Committee yesterday, I would like to ask you, on behalf of the committee and especially on behalf of the rapporteurs, who will debate the topic today, if there are no objections from the Commissioner, with whom I have spoken - and he has no fundamental objections - that we first hear the statement of the Commissioner himself, and then the other rapporteurs can speak in the order determined.

ilsp.query: Wir sollten deshalb eine aktive Politik betreiben, sowohl bei den Fischereiabkommen mit Drittländern, die an die jeweilige Situation anzupassen sind, als auch in den regionalen Fischereiorganisationen, in denen wir, wie so oft gesagt, die Führung übernehmen müssen und uns nicht damit zufrieden geben dürfen, dass die fünfzehn Staaten, die derzeit die Europäische Union bilden - morgen sind es vielleicht zwanzig oder fünfundzwanzig -, immer das gleiche Gewicht behalten wie zum Beispiel heute Estland.
ilsp.judge: We should therefore pursue an active policy, both in the fishing agreements with third countries that need to be adapted to the respective situation, as well as in the regional fishing organizations, in which we, as often said, have to take the lead and cannot be satisfied with the fact that the fifteen states currently forming the European Union - tomorrow it may be twenty or twenty-five - always maintain the same weight, for example, as Estonia does today.
ilsp.proxy: We should therefore pursue an active policy, both in fisheries agreements with third countries, which must be adapted to the respective situation, and in regional fisheries organizations, where we must, as has often been said, take the lead and not be content with the fifteen states that currently form the European Union - tomorrow there may be twenty or twenty-five - always maintaining the same weight as, for example, Estonia does today.

ilsp.query: Im Einzelnen möchte Ihr Berichterstatter einige Vorschläge hervorheben, insbesondere die Aufrechterhaltung des Status quo bezüglich der 6/12-Meilen-Zone. Weiterhin die Beibehaltung der Schutzzonen nach wissenschaftlichen Gutachten und damit zwangsläufig die Frage des Zugangs zur Nordsee, der angesichts der Erweiterungen konsequenter gehandhabt werden muss.
ilsp.judge: In particular, the rapporteur would like to highlight some proposals, especially the maintenance of the status quo regarding the 6/12-mile zone. Furthermore, the retention of protection zones based on scientific assessments, which necessarily raises the question of access to the North Sea, which must be handled more consistently in light of the expansions.

ilsp.query: Das Problem besteht für mich darin, dass es keine Abstimmung zwischen den Bemühungen der verschiedenen Dienste der Kommission gegeben hat, dass kein ausreichender politischer Impuls des Rates vorhanden war und es seitens der Regierung des am stärksten betroffenen Landes keine deutlichen Worte, kein kluges Vorgehen und keine parallele Arbeit gegeben hat, was meiner Meinung nach der gravierendste Punkt ist.
ilsp.judge: The problem lies in the fact that there has been no coordination between the efforts of the various services of the commission, that there was no sufficient political impetus from the council, and that from the government of the most affected country, there were no clear words, no wise approach, and no parallel work, which in my opinion is the most critical point.
ilsp.proxy: The problem for me lies in the fact that there has been no coordination between the efforts of the various Commission services, that there has been no sufficient political impetus from the Council, and that the government of the most affected country has not provided clear words, a smart approach, or parallel work, which I consider to be the most serious point.
ilsp.reference: The problem for me lies in the lack of coordination between the efforts of the various Commission services, the absence of a sufficient political impetus from the Council, and the lack of clear words, wise action, and parallel work on the part of the government of the most affected country, which I consider to be the gravest point.

ilsp.query: Wir verbringen hier ganze Tage mit der Diskussion über das demokratische Defizit und die verantwortungsvolle Regierung der Union und wenn wir dann eine Angelegenheit behandeln, die direkte Auswirkungen auf über 4 000 Fischer hat, wollen wir nicht sehen, was offenkundig ist, und nicht tun, was jede Regierung tun würde, um einen so bedeutenden Teil ihres produktiven Geflechts zu schützen.
ilsp.judge: We spend whole days here discussing the democratic deficit and the Union's responsible government, and when we then deal with a matter that has direct impacts on over 4,000 fishermen, we don't want to see what's obvious and we won't do what any government would do to protect such a significant part of their productive network.
ilsp.proxy: We spend whole days here discussing the democratic deficit and responsible governance of the Union, and when we deal with an issue that has direct implications for over 4,000 fishermen, we refuse to see what is obvious and fail to do what any government would do to protect such a significant part of its productive fabric.
ilsp.reference: We spend entire days discussing the democratic deficit and responsible governance of the Union, and then we address an issue that directly affects over 4,000 fishermen, yet we refuse to see what is obvious and fail to do what any government would do to protect such an important part of its productive fabric.

ilsp.query: Jetzt müssen wir daran arbeiten, dass gerade in diesem beispielhaften Sektor die gemeinsame Politik nicht aufgegeben wird, doch um dies zu tun, müssen wir denjenigen eine Antwort geben, die sich darüber beklagen - und das sind die Akteure -, dass es keine ausreichende Mitwirkung gibt, dass keine Zustimmung zu den getroffenen Entscheidungen eingeholt wird, mit anderen Worten, dass keine Teilhabe am Entscheidungsprozess stattfindet.
ilsp.judge: Now we need to work on the fact that in this exemplary sector, the joint policy is not being given up, but to do this, we need to give an answer to those who complain about it - and that are the actors - that there is insufficient participation, that no consent is obtained for the decisions made, in other words, that there is no involvement in the decision-making process.
ilsp.proxy: Now we must work to ensure that in this exemplary sector, the common policy is not abandoned; however, to do this, we must respond to those who complain - and these are the actors - that there is not enough participation, that there is no agreement on the decisions made, in other words, that there is no involvement in the decision-making process.
ilsp.reference: Now we must ensure that in this exemplary sector, the common policy is not abandoned, but to do so, we must address those who complain – and they are the actors – that there is not enough participation, that consent to the decisions made is not sought, in other words, that there is no involvement in the decision-making process.

ilsp.query: Betrachtet man die heutigen Zahlen, so stellt man plötzlich fest, dass mit einem Wirtschaftswachstum von 5 % des BSP pro Kopf, einem Exportzuwachs von nicht weniger als 12,8 % in den fünf Jahren zwischen 1993 und 1998 und sogar einem Rückgang des Bevölkerungswachstums - Senkung der Fruchtbarkeitsrate von 7 auf heute 3 Geburten je Frau - die Entwicklung als eine Erfolgsstory beschrieben werden könnte.
ilsp.judge: Examining the current numbers, one suddenly finds that with an economic growth of 5% of GDP per capita, an increase in exports of no less than 12.8% over the five years between 1993 and 1998, and even a decline in population growth - a decrease in the fertility rate from 7 to today's 3 births per woman - the development could be described as a success story.
ilsp.proxy: When looking at today's figures, one suddenly realizes that with a GDP per capita growth of 5%, an export increase of no less than 12.8% over the five years between 1993 and 1998, and even a decline in population growth - reducing the fertility rate from 7 to now 3 births per woman - the development could be described as a success story.
ilsp.reference: When considering today's numbers, one suddenly realizes that with an economic growth rate of 5% per capita GDP, an export increase of at least 12.8% over five years from 1993 to 1998, and even a decline in population growth – a fertility rate dropping from 7 to 3 births per woman today – this development could be described as a success story.

ilsp.query: Wir reden nicht über den letzten Beweis, und als wir in diesem Haus über unsere eigene Gesundheit und über BSE gesprochen haben, da waren wir uns auch alle einig, dass das Vorsorgeprinzip gilt, obwohl wir niemals den direkten Beweis führen konnten, dass infiziertes Material zu der neuen Variante der Creutzfeldt-Jacob-Krankheit führt.
ilsp.judge: We're not talking about the final proof, and when we were in this house discussing our own health and BSE, we were all in agreement that the precautionary principle applies, even though we could never lead direct evidence that infected material leads to the new variant of Creutzfeldt-Jacob disease.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, wir behandeln heute ein äußerst wichtiges Thema, auf das eigentlich sehr viel Zeit verwendet und zu dem sehr eingehende Überlegungen angestellt werden müssten, während wir es allerdings voller Emotionen angehen, die der Politik, zu der wir doch hier als Nichtfachleute gehalten sind, schlecht zu Gesicht stehen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, we are dealing with a very important issue today, which actually requires a lot of time and thorough considerations, while we are approaching it full of emotions, which do not look good for the politics we are representing here as non-experts.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, we are dealing with an extremely important topic today, one that should actually require a great deal of time and very thorough consideration, yet we approach it with full emotions, which do not look good for the politics to which we are supposed to be laymen here.

ilsp.query: Folglich ist - und ich darf Ihnen sagen, dass es keine schädliche Substanz gibt, die selbst bei Aufnahme in kleinen Dosen keinen Schaden verursachen würde - eine akribische epidemiologische Studie erforderlich, sowohl im Golf als auch in Bosnien und selbstverständlich im Kosovo, obgleich die Folgen dort erst später spürbar werden.
ilsp.judge: Consequently - and I may say to you that there is no harmful substance that would not cause any harm even at intake in small doses - a meticulous epidemiological study is required, both in the Gulf and in Bosnia, and of course in Kosovo, although the consequences there will only be noticeable later.
ilsp.proxy: Consequently, and I may tell you that there is no harmful substance which would not cause damage even when taken in small doses, an meticulous epidemiological study is required, both in the Gulf and in Bosnia and, of course, in Kosovo, although the effects there will only be felt later.
ilsp.reference: Consequently, and I can tell you that there is no harmful substance that would cause harm even when ingested in small doses, a meticulous epidemiological study is required, both in the Gulf and in Bosnia, and of course in Kosovo, although the consequences there will become apparent only later.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich möchte zunächst allen Mitgliedern des Europäischen Parlaments für ihre Erklärungen danken, durch die unterstrichen wurde, dass wir die Ängste und Befürchtungen all derjenigen ernst nehmen müssen, die an Symptomen und Erkrankungen leiden, und dass wir alle verfügbaren Informationen zusammentragen und auch die langfristigen Gesundheitsauswirkungen untersuchen müssen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, I would like to thank all members of the European Parliament first for their statements, which have underscored that we must take seriously the fears and concerns of all those who suffer from symptoms and illnesses, and that we must gather all available information and also investigate the long-term health effects.

ilsp.query: Daher hätten wir eine umfassendere Finanzierung gewünscht, eine stärkere Koordinierung zur höheren Wirksamkeit der verschiedenen Programme, die angewendet werden können, sowie eine stärkere Mitverantwortung im Hinblick auf die spätere - manchmal leider notwendige - militärische Intervention, die möglicherweise nicht erforderlich wäre, wenn die vorangehenden Phasen realisiert würden.
ilsp.judge: Therefore, we would have wished for a more comprehensive financing, a stronger coordination for the higher effectiveness of the various programs that can be applied, as well as a stronger co-responsibility in view of the later - sometimes unfortunately necessary - military intervention, which might not be necessary if the preceding phases were realized.
ilsp.proxy: Therefore, we would have wished for more comprehensive financing, stronger coordination for the greater effectiveness of the various programs that can be applied, as well as greater shared responsibility regarding the later - sometimes unfortunately necessary - military intervention, which might not be required if the preceding phases were implemented.
ilsp.reference: Therefore, we would have preferred more comprehensive financing, stronger coordination for higher effectiveness of the various programs that can be applied, as well as greater shared responsibility regarding any subsequent - sometimes unfortunately necessary - military intervention, which might not be required if the preceding phases were realized.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, im Zusammenhang mit der Diskussion über dieses Thema begrüße ich den Vorschlag des schwedischen Außenministeriums über einen zielorientierten Aktionsplan zur Konfliktverhütung, den ich erst heute erhalten habe. Ich unterstütze diesen Vorschlag, weil ich, wie ich bereits sagte, der Auffassung bin, dass die Europäische Union in Krisenregionen eine Anleitung zum Frieden schicken sollte und nicht nur Streitkräfte.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, in connection with the discussion on this topic, I welcome the proposal of the Swedish Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a goal-oriented action plan for conflict prevention, which I have only just received today. I support this proposal because, as I have already said, I am of the opinion that the European Union should send guidance for peace to crisis regions and not just military forces.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, in connection with the discussion on this topic, I welcome the proposal of the Swedish Foreign Ministry for a targeted action plan for conflict prevention, which I received only today. I support this proposal because, as I have already stated, I believe that the European Union should send a guide to peace to crisis regions and not just armed forces.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, in connection with the discussion on this topic, I welcome the proposal by the Swedish Foreign Ministry for a goal-oriented action plan for conflict prevention, which I received only today. I support this proposal because, as I have already said, I believe that the European Union should send a message of peace to crisis regions and not just deploy military forces.

ilsp.query: Nichtsdestotrotz spüre ich eine gewisse Zuversicht und stelle fest, dass die EU-Staaten unkoordiniert angetreten sind - Herr Brok hat soeben davon gesprochen -, um die Anerkennung des stalinistischen Regimes von Pjöngjang zu wetteifern, wobei sie die Augen vor den Geschehnissen innerhalb des Landes, vor den dramatischen Menschenrechtsverletzungen, verschließen.
ilsp.judge: Despite this, I sense a certain optimism and I note that the EU member states have embarked on this uncoordinated - as Mr. Brok has just mentioned - competition to recognize the Stalinist regime in Pyongyang, while turning a blind eye to the events within the country, to the dramatic human rights abuses.
ilsp.proxy: Notwithstanding, I feel a certain optimism and observe that the EU states have acted uncoordinated - Mr. Brok has just spoken about this - to compete for the recognition of the Stalinist regime in Pyongyang, while turning a blind eye to events within the country and the dramatic human rights violations.
ilsp.reference: Nevertheless, I feel a certain optimism and note that the EU states have acted uncoordinatedly – as Mr. Brok just mentioned – in competing for recognition of the Stalinist regime in Pyongyang, while turning a blind eye to the events within the country, including the dramatic human rights violations.

ilsp.query: Wir müssen, auch in der Welthandelsorganisation, die Ursprungsbezeichnungen unserer Qualitätsprodukte, u. a. des Weins, verteidigen und sichern, denn unsere Zukunft in der EU und was den Export in Drittländer betrifft, liegt in Produkten hochwertiger Qualität, für die es bei uns, und auch in der Welt, zahlungskräftige und mündige Verbraucher gibt.
ilsp.judge: We must, also within the World Trade Organization, defend and secure the origin designations of our high-quality products, including wine, as our future in the EU and with regard to exports to third countries depends on products of superior quality, for which there are price-paying and informed consumers both at home and around the world.
ilsp.proxy: We must defend and secure the origin designations of our quality products, including wine, even within the World Trade Organization, because our future in the EU and regarding exports to third countries lies in high-quality products for which there are solvent and mature consumers both here and in the world.
ilsp.reference: We must defend and secure the origin designations of our quality products, including wine, in the World Trade Organization, as our future in the EU and for exports to third countries lies in high-quality products for which there are financially sound and discerning consumers both here and around the world.

ilsp.query: Seit Beginn des Atomzeitalters mit dem Zweiten Weltkrieg sind die Gefahren und Vorsorgemaßnahmen wohl bekannt, die man beim Umgang mit Uran und anderen radioaktiven Stoffen beachten muss, weil es sich um ein hochtoxisches (chemisch und radiologisch toxisches) Element handelt, wenn man es einatmet oder aufnimmt, das auch genetisch gefährlich ist.
ilsp.judge: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and preventive measures are well known that one must observe when handling uranium and other radioactive substances, because it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that is also genetically hazardous if inhaled or ingested.
ilsp.proxy: Since the beginning of the atomic age with the Second World War, the dangers and precautionary measures that must be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive materials have been well known, as they are highly toxic (both chemically and radiologically) elements that can be dangerous if inhaled or ingested, and are also genetically hazardous.
ilsp.reference: Since the beginning of the atomic age, starting with World War II, the dangers and precautionary measures that must be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive substances are well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that can be hazardous to genetic material if inhaled or ingested.

ilsp.query: Ich habe im letzten Jahr außerdem mit Sorge beobachtet, dass die derzeitige russische Führung - zu der viele ehemalige KGB-Mitarbeiter gehören, die von Präsident Putin, der ja früher selbst KGB-Oberst war, berufen wurden - großen Eifer bei der Verhaftung so genannter britischer, amerikanischer und russischer Spione an den Tag gelegt hat.
ilsp.judge: I have also been observing with concern in the past year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees who were appointed by President Putin, who was himself a KGB colonel in the past - has shown great zeal in the arrest of so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
ilsp.proxy: I have also observed with concern over the past year that the current Russian leadership, which includes many former KGB employees appointed by President Putin, who was himself formerly a KGB colonel, has shown great zeal in the arrest of so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
