ilsp.query: Wenn es Ihnen gelingt, Ihre Landsleute davon zu überzeugen, dass der Euro ein gutes Projekt ist, dass er nach innen stabil ist, dass seine Stabilität nach außen auch immer besser wird, wenn Sie sie davon überzeugen können, dieses große Werk der europäischen Integration mitzutragen, tragen Sie damit auch dazu bei, dass dieser Bereich der Europäischen Union auch von den Bürgern besser verstanden werden kann.
ilsp.judge: If you succeed in convincing your fellow countrymen that the Euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its stability will also improve externally, and if you can convince them to contribute to this great work of European integration, you will also contribute to the fact that this area of the European Union can be better understood by its citizens.
ilsp.proxy: If you manage to convince your fellow citizens that the euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, and that its stability is also increasingly better externally, and if you can persuade them to contribute to this great work of European integration, you will also be helping to ensure that this area of the European Union is better understood by its citizens.
ilsp.reference: If you manage to convince your fellow citizens that the Euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, and that its stability is getting better externally over time, and if you can persuade them to contribute to this great work of European integration, then you will also help to ensure that this area of the European Union is better understood by its citizens.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson hat wirklich einen ausgezeichneten Bericht vorgelegt. Ich kann das behaupten, weil ich wohl zu den wenigen gehöre, die nicht nur politisch, sondern auch fachlich mit diesem Sektor vertraut sind, denn bevor ich mich meiner Tätigkeit als Abgeordneter dieses Parlaments zuwandte, hatte ich etwa 10 000 Flugstunden als Mitglied einer Cockpitbesatzung absolviert.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has really presented an excellent report. I can say that because I probably belong to the few who are not only politically but also professionally familiar with this sector, because before I turned to my activity as a member of this parliament, I had about 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has truly presented an excellent report. I can say this because I probably belong to the few who are not only politically but also professionally familiar with this sector, as before I devoted myself to my work as a Member of this Parliament, I had accumulated about 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has indeed presented an excellent report. I can say this because I am one of the few who are not only politically but also professionally familiar with this sector, as before I devoted myself to my work as a Member of this Parliament, I had accumulated approximately 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.

ilsp.query: Entweder einigen sich die Parteien bis zum Mai, oder wir erwarten, dass die Kommission einen Vorschlag macht, den wir in die zweite Lesung einbauen können, denn es geht nicht an, dass die entscheidende Frage für die Sicherheit der Passagiere, nämlich, ob die Kapitäne, die Besatzungen, so ausgeruht sind, dass sie ihre Aufgaben wahrnehmen können, nicht geregelt wird.
ilsp.judge: Either the parties will agree by May, or we expect the commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it's not acceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether the captains and crews are so well-rested that they can perform their duties, is not regulated.
ilsp.proxy: Either the parties agree by May, or we expect the Commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it is unacceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether the captains and crews are sufficiently rested to perform their duties, remains unregulated.
ilsp.reference: Either the parties reach an agreement by May, or we expect the Commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, as it is unacceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether the captains and crew are sufficiently rested to perform their duties, remains unresolved.

ilsp.query: Davon ausgehend verfolgt die von uns vorgeschlagene Änderung zur bestehenden Verordnung ein zweifaches Ziel: Zum einen zielt sie auf die weitere Harmonisierung des Regulierungssystems im Bereich der Sicherheit der Zivilluftfahrt durch seine Ausdehnung auf die Harmonisierung der Betriebsanforderungen für Luftfahrzeuge; zum anderen geht es um die Festlegung von Verfahren, die es der Gemeinschaft ermöglichen, die Varianten und die Ausnahmen zu bearbeiten, die die Mitgliedstaaten hin und wieder aus operativen Erfordernissen anwenden müssen.
ilsp.judge:
# English
Starting from this, the proposed amendment to the existing regulation pursues a twofold objective: On the one hand, it aims at further harmonization of the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety through its extension to the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that enable the community to handle the variants and exceptions that Member States occasionally have to apply from operational requirements.
ilsp.proxy: The proposed amendment to the existing regulation pursues a twofold objective: On the one hand, it aims at further harmonizing the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that enable the Community to handle the variants and exceptions that Member States occasionally have to apply for operational reasons.
ilsp.reference: Based on this, our proposed amendment to the existing regulation aims at achieving a dual objective: on the one hand, it seeks to further harmonize the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to include the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it focuses on establishing procedures that will enable the community to address the variations and exceptions that member states must occasionally apply due to operational necessities.

ilsp.query: Schaffen wir Vorschriften, suchen wir nach einem größeren Harmonisierungsgrad, fördern wir Maßnahmen, um den Fußgänger- und Fahrradverkehr vernünftig und sicher zu gestalten, und suchen wir nach Formeln zur Reduzierung des Schwerlastverkehrs, zumindest in den Ortschaften; harmonisieren wir die Geschwindigkeitsbeschränkungen durch einen ambitiösen Rechtsrahmen, wie von der Kommission 1986 vorgeschlagen wurde, indem wir die Mitgliedstaaten aus ihrer Trägheit wecken.
ilsp.judge: Let's create regulations, seek a higher degree of harmonization, promote measures to reasonably and safely arrange pedestrian and bicycle traffic, and seek formulas to reduce heavy traffic, at least in local communities; harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legislative framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking the member states from their lethargy.
ilsp.proxy: When we establish regulations, we seek a greater degree of harmonization, promote measures to make pedestrian and bicycle traffic reasonable and safe, and look for formulas to reduce heavy goods traffic, at least in urban areas; we harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking up the Member States from their inertia.
ilsp.reference: Let us create regulations, seek a greater degree of harmonization, promote measures to design pedestrian and bicycle traffic reasonably and safely, and look for formulas to reduce heavy goods vehicle traffic, at least in urban areas; harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking up the Member States from their inertia.

ilsp.query: Was nützt das Bedauern darüber, dass 95 % der Verkehrsunfälle auf den Straßenverkehr und damit nur ein äußert geringer Teil auf den Eisenbahn- und den Flugverkehr entfallen, wenn die Politik aller Regierungen darin besteht, offen oder de facto das Auto gegenüber allen anderen Verkehrsmitteln zur Personen- oder Güterbeförderung zu bevorteilen.
ilsp.judge: What's the point of lamenting that 95% of accidents occur on road traffic and thus only an extremely small part on rail and air traffic, if the policy of all governments consists in openly or de facto favoring the car over all other modes of transport for the transportation of people or goods.
ilsp.proxy: What good is it to regret that 95% of traffic accidents occur on road traffic and thus only an extremely small part affects rail and air traffic, if the policy of all governments is to favor the car over all other means of transport for passenger or freight transport, either openly or de facto.
ilsp.reference: What use is lamenting the fact that 95% of traffic accidents occur on roads, and thus only an extremely small part occur in rail and air transport, when all governments' policies consist of openly or de facto favoring cars over all other modes of transportation for passenger or goods transport?

ilsp.query: Zum einen würde kein EU-Staat akzeptieren, wenn ein anderer Mitgliedstaat tolerieren würde, dass ein Flugkapitän in einem Flugzeug mit 300 Passagieren, ein Kapitän zur See, der für die Sicherheit von 1 000 Personen verantwortlich ist, oder ein Lokführer Alkohol trinken würde, bevor er die Verantwortung für seine Passagiere übernimmt.
ilsp.judge: First and foremost, no EU state would accept if another member state would tolerate a flight captain drinking alcohol in a plane with 300 passengers, a ship's captain responsible for the safety of 1,000 people, or a train conductor drinking alcohol before taking responsibility for their passengers.
ilsp.proxy: On the one hand, no EU country would accept if another member state tolerated a flight captain drinking alcohol before taking responsibility for 300 passengers on an airplane, a sea captain responsible for the safety of 1,000 people, or a train driver doing the same before taking charge of their passengers.
ilsp.reference: For one thing, no EU state would accept it if another member state tolerated a situation where a flight captain on a plane carrying 300 passengers, a ship captain responsible for the safety of 1,000 people, or a locomotive driver drank alcohol before taking responsibility for their passengers.

ilsp.query: In einer ersten Etappe müssen die letzten vorrangigen Maßnahmen, die im Rahmen des derzeit laufenden Programms über die Straßenverkehrssicherheit festgelegt wurden, verwirklicht werden. Insbesondere ist vorzuschlagen, dass die Pflicht zum Einbau von Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzern auf eine größere Zahl von Lastkraftwagen angewendet wird, indem Fahrzeuge mit geringerer Nutzlast einbezogen werden.
ilsp.judge: In the first stage, the last priority measures that have been established within the framework of the current program on road traffic safety must be implemented. In particular, it is recommended that the obligation to install speed limiters be applied to a larger number of heavy goods vehicles by including vehicles with lower payload.
ilsp.proxy: In the first stage, the last priority measures set out in the current program on road safety must be implemented. In particular, it is proposed that the obligation to install speed limiters should be extended to a larger number of trucks, by including vehicles with lower payload.
ilsp.reference: In the first stage, the final priority measures that have been established for road traffic safety within the current program must be implemented. In particular, it is proposed that the obligation to install speed limiters be extended to a larger number of trucks, including those with lower load capacities.

ilsp.query: Analysiert man die Reibungskosten im intermodalen Güterverkehr im Einzelnen, so ist festzustellen, dass die Hauptproblempunkte gegenüber dem traditionellen unimodalen Verkehr in höheren Preisen, längeren Fahrzeiten, zunehmenden von den Gütern zurückgelegten durchschnittlichen Entfernungen, Qualitätsminderung, größeren Beschädigungsrisiken, Beschränkungen bezüglich der Art der beförderten Güter sowie komplexeren Verwaltungsverfahren liegen.
ilsp.judge: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it can be determined that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, quality degradation, greater damage risks, restrictions on the type of goods being transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
ilsp.proxy: When analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it can be observed that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances traveled by goods, quality degradation, greater risk of damage, restrictions on the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
ilsp.reference: When analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it becomes apparent that the main issues compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer transit times, increased average distances traveled by the goods, quality degradation, greater risk of damage, limitations regarding the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte die von uns allen mitgetragenen Schwerpunkte noch einmal nennen: Kostenaufteilung in einem direkteren Verhältnis zur Nutzung der Infrastrukturen; Berücksichtigung der sozialen Kosten, aber auch Schutz benachteiligter Gebiete und Bevölkerungsgruppen; Förderung der Umweltverträglichkeit, aber gleichzeitig auch Durchsetzung des Rechts auf Mobilität als Universalrecht.
ilsp.judge: I would like to mention the points that we all have agreed on once again: cost allocation in a more direct proportion to the use of infrastructure; consideration of social costs, but also protection of disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental compatibility, but at the same time also enforcement of the right to mobility as a universal right.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to restate the key points we all share: cost distribution in a more direct proportion to the use of infrastructures; consideration of social costs, but also protection of disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental compatibility, but at the same time enforcement of the right to mobility as a universal right.
ilsp.reference: I would like to reiterate the focal points that we have all agreed upon: cost allocation in a more direct proportion to the use of infrastructure; consideration of social costs, but also protection for disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental sustainability, but at the same time enforcement of the right to mobility as a universal right.

ilsp.query: Diese Frage der Gebührengestaltung ist also von absolut zentraler Bedeutung. Wenn wir wirklich die gewünschte Verkehrsverlagerung erreichen wollen, müssen wir daher den Mut aufbringen, effektiv eine Internalisierung der externen Kosten herbeizuführen, d. h. dass im Straßenverkehr das bezahlt wird, was er wirklich kostet, dass im Eisenbahnverkehr bezahlt wird, was er kostet und dass die Kostenklarheit zur Preiswahrheit führt.
ilsp.judge: The question of how to structure fees is thus of absolute central importance. If we really want to achieve the desired traffic diversion, we must therefore muster the courage to effectively internalize external costs, i.e., that in road traffic, what it really costs is paid for, that in rail traffic, what it costs is paid for, and that cost transparency leads to price truth.
ilsp.proxy: This issue of fee structuring is therefore of absolute central importance. If we really want to achieve the desired shift in traffic, we must have the courage to effectively bring about the internalization of external costs, i.e., that in road traffic, what it really costs is paid, that in rail traffic, what it costs is paid, and that cost transparency leads to price truth.
ilsp.reference: This question of fee setting is therefore of absolute central importance. If we really want to achieve the desired shift in traffic, we must therefore muster the courage to effectively internalize external costs, i.e., that road traffic pays what it really costs, that rail transport pays what it costs, and that cost clarity leads to price truth.

ilsp.query: Der Bericht ist gut strukturiert und stellt einen soliden Beitrag zum Verständnis der Politik der Erhebung von Infrastrukturgebühren sowie für ihre Anwendung dar. Dies ist eine Kernfrage, um der Verkehrspolitik eine Orientierung zu geben, um eine Politik zu entwickeln, die den Verkehr und eine dauerhafte Mobilität für die Zukunft gewährleistet, und um in vernünftiger Art und Weise dem außerordentlichen Bedarf Rechnung zu tragen, den wir in den nächsten Jahren bewältigen müssen.
ilsp.judge: The report is well-structured and provides a solid contribution to the understanding of the policy on infrastructure charges as well as its application. This is a key issue to provide orientation to transport policy, to develop a policy that ensures traffic and sustainable mobility for the future, and to reasonably account for the extraordinary demand that we must address in the coming years.
ilsp.proxy: The report is well-structured and represents a solid contribution to understanding the policy of charging infrastructure fees as well as their application. This is a core issue to guide traffic policy in developing a strategy that ensures traffic and sustainable mobility for the future, and to address the extraordinary needs we must tackle in the coming years in a reasonable manner.
ilsp.reference: The report is well-structured and makes a solid contribution to understanding the policy on the collection of infrastructure charges as well as their application. This is a key issue to provide orientation for transport policy, to develop a policy that secures traffic and sustainable mobility for the future, and to take reasonable account of the exceptional demand we will have to meet in the coming years.

ilsp.query: Dies bedeutet auch, dass Männer und Frauen in Bereichen des öffentlichen und privaten Lebens die gleiche Verantwortung übernehmen, um neue Praktiken gegen die Diskriminierung zu fördern, und zwar auch in den politischen Parteien und öffentlichen und privaten Verwaltungen. Das Ziel muss lauten, psychologische und praktische Hindernisse für die Mitwirkung der Frauen in den Entscheidungsgremien und im politischen Leben auszuräumen und so Rückschritten wie der kürzlichen Abschaffung des Gleichstellungsministeriums durch die Regierung in Portugal zu begegnen.
ilsp.judge: This also means that men and women in public and private life take on the same responsibility to promote new practices against discrimination, including in political parties and public and private administrations. The goal must be to remove psychological and practical obstacles for women's participation in decision-making bodies and in political life, and thus counter setbacks such as the recent abolition of the Ministry of Equality by the government in Portugal.
ilsp.proxy: This also means that men and women in areas of public and private life should take on equal responsibility to promote new practices against discrimination, including within political parties and public and private administrations. The goal must be to remove psychological and practical barriers to women's participation in decision-making bodies and political life, thus countering setbacks such as the recent abolition of the Ministry for Equality by the government in Portugal.
ilsp.reference: This also means that men and women in both public and private spheres should take on the same responsibility for promoting new practices against discrimination, including within political parties and public and private administrations. The goal must be to remove psychological and practical barriers to women's participation in decision-making bodies and political life, thereby confronting setbacks such as the recent abolition of the Ministry for Equality by the Portuguese government.

ilsp.query: Lino Miserotti sagte zu mir: "Ich als Rentner finde es richtig, dass ich für die Benutzung dieser Autobahn eine Maut bezahlen muss, denn so leiste ich einen Beitrag zum Bau und zur Unterhaltung von Autobahnen, die eine wichtige Verkehrsinfrastruktur darstellen. Doch es wäre gut, wenn die Arbeitnehmer, die einer Arbeit nachgehen und sich noch nicht im Ruhestand befinden, von der Gebührenzahlung befreit würden. "
ilsp.judge: Lino Miserotti told me: "As a retiree, I think it's right that I have to pay a toll for using this highway because in this way I contribute to the construction and maintenance of highways, which represent an important traffic infrastructure. However, it would be good if working people, who are still employed and not yet in retirement, were exempt from paying the fee."
ilsp.proxy: Lino Miserotti said to me: "As a retiree, I find it right that I have to pay tolls for using this highway, because in this way I contribute to the construction and maintenance of highways, which are an important part of the transportation infrastructure. However, it would be good if workers who are still employed and not yet retired were exempt from paying the fees."
ilsp.reference: Lino Miserotti told me: "As a retiree, I find it right that I have to pay a toll for using this motorway, because in this way I contribute to the construction and maintenance of motorways, which represent an important transportation infrastructure. However, it would be good if employees who are still working and not yet retired were exempt from paying the toll."

ilsp.query: Für uns sollte dies Anlass ein, unsere Stimme zu erheben, um diese Machenschaften Russlands gegenüber seinem ehemaligen Vasallen zu verurteilen, und durch konkretes Handeln zur politischen Stabilisierung dieser Region und ihrem ökonomischen Aufschwung beizutragen. Und dann sollten wir, wie in der Entschließung vorgeschlagen, einen Sondergesandten für den Südkaukasus benennen, denn ein Flächenbrand im Südkaukasus würde auch Europa nicht verschonen.
ilsp.judge: For us, this should be a reason to raise our voice to condemn Russia's machinations against its former vassal, and to contribute to the political stabilization of this region and its economic upswing through concrete action. And then we should, as proposed in the resolution, appoint a special envoy for the South Caucasus, because a fire in the South Caucasus would not spare Europe either.
ilsp.proxy: For us, this should be an occasion to raise our voice to condemn Russia's machinations against its former vassal, and to contribute to the political stabilization of this region and its economic upswing through concrete action. And then we should, as proposed in the resolution, appoint a special envoy for the South Caucasus, because a wildfire in the South Caucasus would not spare Europe either.
ilsp.reference: For us, this should serve as an opportunity to raise our voice to condemn Russia's machinations against its former vassal, and through concrete action, contribute to the political stabilization of this region and its economic upswing. And then, as proposed in the resolution, we should appoint a special envoy for the South Caucasus, for a conflagration in the South Caucasus would not spare Europe either.
